Challenge name: Track anything that moves - Build a Movesense based tracking concept for sports, health or something else
Description: The world is full of things that move – whether it’s an athlete’s body or sports equipment, a machine on a production line, a bridge under traffic, any of us in our daily life, or anything else that we can imagine. Often it would be highly valuable to know how and when these things move – or don’t move. Movesense offers a programmable motion sensor, API’s and software libraries that enable you to quickly build your own sensor functions and mobile applications to track anything that moves. Help the world to stay on the move!
Insights:
Participants will have an opportunity to build applications to the Movesense sensor and compatible mobile apps to iOS and Android. Sample apps for the sensor and mobile phone enable raw data collection and show how data can be processed and stored with the sensor and a mobile device. The whole system is based on simple REST API’s. The sensor is programmed with C++. A data connection with IBM Bluemix and Microsoft Azure will be available.
What we’ll bring:
-        A batch of Movesense sensors, enough for all projects. The sensor you use will be yours to keep after the hack if you submit a project to this challenge.
-        Programming jigs for fast upload and debugging of the sensor apps
-        Our Movesense software experts to support your work
Resources: Find out more at www.movesense.com.\nhttps://bitbucket.org/suunto/movesense-device-lib (public from early September)\nhttps://bitbucket.org/suunto/movesense-mobile-lib (will be made public soon)
Judging criteria: How can motion tracking help to optimize training of strength, speed, technique, balance, agility, tactics, or any other specific or generic area of sports performance that is not measured today?\nWhat about health and wellbeing? There is much more than daily steps and calories that we need to know to live a healthy live or to recover after a health problem. Can you improve our life quality with motion tracking?\nOr would you rather track something else than human beings? Optimize a production process? Digitalize agriculture? Improve logistics? There are so many moving things in the world. But, when and how to move or not to move? Well, that’s the question.
Prizes: All teams that submit a Movesense based project can keep the Movesense sensors used in development. As winner prizes, we will hand out the latest Suunto Spartan watch for each team member of the best solutions in three categories: 1. Sports 2. Health and Wellbeing 3. General IoT In addition, teams with commercially viable solutions for sports and daily wellbeing will have an opportunity to talk with Suunto about partnering options.
Links: The main criteria are the level of added value provided to the selected use case, functional readiness of the concept, and perceived user experience. If you solve an obvious need or a problem with Movesense in an elegant and easy to use way, your chances of winning are high.
About Company: Suunto is a Finnish manufacturer of world renowned sports watches, dive computers and precision instruments for the toughest conditions. Our new initiative, Movesense, is an open development environment and a programmable sensor for motion tracking and other sensoring for and beyond sports. With Movesense, you can commercialize your own sensor ideas quickly and cost effectively without having to worry about hardware development and manufacturing.
name_zh: 追踪任何移动的事物——基于 Movesense 构建运动、健康或其他领域的追踪概念
description_zh: 世界上充满了移动的事物——无论是运动员的身体或运动装备、生产线上的机器、交通中的桥梁、我们日常生活中的任何人，还是我们能想象到的任何其他事物。通常，了解这些事物如何以及何时移动——或者不移动——会非常有价值。Movesense 提供可编程的运动传感器、API 和软件库，使您能够快速构建自己的传感器功能和移动应用程序，以追踪任何移动的事物。帮助世界保持移动！
insights_zh:
参与者将有机会为 Movesense 传感器构建应用程序，并为 iOS 和 Android 构建兼容的移动应用。传感器和手机的示例应用支持原始数据收集，并展示如何使用传感器和移动设备处理和存储数据。整个系统基于简单的 REST API。传感器使用 C++ 编程。将提供与 IBM Bluemix 和 Microsoft Azure 的数据连接。
我们将提供：
- 一批 Movesense 传感器，足够所有项目使用。如果您向此挑战提交项目，您使用的传感器将在黑客松后归您所有。
- 用于快速上传和调试传感器应用程序的编程夹具
- 我们的 Movesense 软件专家支持您的工作
judging_criteria_zh:
运动追踪如何帮助优化力量、速度、技术、平衡、敏捷性、战术或当今尚未测量的任何其他特定或通用运动表现领域的训练？
健康和福祉呢？要过上健康的生活或在健康问题后恢复，我们需要了解的远不止每日步数和卡路里。您能否通过运动追踪提高我们的生活质量？
或者您更愿意追踪人类以外的其他事物？优化生产过程？数字化农业？改善物流？世界上有太多移动的事物。但是，何时以及如何移动或不移动？嗯，这就是问题所在。
prizes_zh: 所有提交基于 Movesense 项目的团队都可以保留开发中使用的 Movesense 传感器。作为获胜奖品，我们将为三个类别中最佳解决方案的每位团队成员颁发最新的 Suunto Spartan 手表：1. 运动 2. 健康与福祉 3. 通用物联网。此外，拥有运动与日常健康商业可行解决方案的团队将有机会与 Suunto 洽谈合作选项。
resources_zh:
更多信息请访问 www.movesense.com。
https://bitbucket.org/suunto/movesense-device-lib （9月初公开）
https://bitbucket.org/suunto/movesense-mobile-lib （即将公开）
links_zh: 主要标准是为所选用例提供的附加值水平、概念的功能完备性以及感知的用户体验。如果您以优雅且易于使用的方式用 Movesense 解决了一个明显的需求或问题，您获胜的机会就很高。
about_company_zh: Suunto 是一家芬兰制造商，生产世界知名的运动手表、潜水电脑和适用于最恶劣条件的精密仪器。我们的新计划 Movesense 是一个开放开发环境和可编程传感器，用于运动追踪及其他传感，服务于运动及更广泛领域。借助 Movesense，您可以快速且经济高效地将自己的传感器创意商业化，而无需担心硬件开发和制造。

Challenge name: Changing the financial management landscape - Simplify financial management for entrepreneurs.
Description: Let entrepreneurs focus on their business and competitive strengths by streamlining and automating financial management. Invoicing, payroll, cash flow and other financial management routines take time away from other aspects of the business. We look for ways to minimize the time spent on these routine tasks in favor of focusing on your domain.
Insights: Procountor will provide access to APIs in a public test environment, as well as access to the core web application in that environment. We will also have mentors present to help you out!
Resources: https://dev.procountor.com
Judging criteria: Example of possible hacks include a mobile application to create invoices using Procountor's APIs, or an OCR application that can scan invoices.
Prizes: 1000e for main challenge, 500e for best use of API
Links: We judge solutions mainly on their impact and utility. Effective use of our APIs is a bonus but is not required.
About Company: Procountor is a friendly accounting software for SMEs and accountants. Our product is currently available in Finland, Sweden, Norway and Denmark.
name_zh: 改变财务管理格局——为企业家简化财务管理
description_zh: 通过简化和自动化财务管理，让企业家能够专注于自身业务和竞争优势。开票、薪资、现金流及其他财务管理常规工作会占用本可用于业务其他方面的时间。我们寻求各种方法，以尽量减少花在这些常规任务上的时间，从而让您专注于自己的领域。
insights_zh: Procountor 将在公共测试环境中提供 API 访问权限，以及该环境中核心 Web 应用程序的访问权限。我们还将安排导师在场为您提供帮助！
judging_criteria_zh: 可能的黑客方案示例包括：使用 Procountor 的 API 创建发票的移动应用程序，或可扫描发票的 OCR 应用程序。
prizes_zh: 主挑战奖金 1000 欧元，最佳 API 使用奖 500 欧元
resources_zh: https://dev.procountor.com
links_zh: 我们主要根据解决方案的影响力和实用性进行评判。有效使用我们的 API 是加分项，但并非必需。
about_company_zh: Procountor 是一款面向中小企业和会计师的友好会计软件。我们的产品目前已在芬兰、瑞典、挪威和丹麦上市。

Challenge name: Who needs a light switch? - Automate the whole process of controlling light.
Description: People are too lazy to control the lights manually! Help us to either automate the whole process or at least by giving the user a really frictionless control. Test your innovativeness by finding new ways to increase people well-being with intelligent algorithms and/or the newest sensors…
Insights:
To help you accomplish this, we will provide you with top of the line professional lighting system in the Smart Room. Our REST API can be used to control the light level, color temperature, RGB color and fade times. Our API also provides you with live feed from various sensors and input devices:
 
 1. Light intensity sensors
 2. Any button presses in the lighting system
 3. Passive infrared (PIR) sensors
 4. Mood rings http://www.moodmetric.com
 5. Infrared camera http://www.flir.com/cores/lepton/
 
 You are also free to use any sensors in your own laptops or mobile devices
Judging criteria: 1. Automatic and advanced lighting control with no need for user commands.\n 2. Optimizing the lighting system by learning from the sensor data.\n 3. New user interfaces to control lighting effortlessly.
Prizes: 1st price: Hubsan H501S quadcopters (or equivalent) for the winning team. Honorable mention: Amazon Echo Dot devices for selected teams.
Links: The main criteria for winning is the innovativeness of the solution. Together with that and a cool demo with use cases you will get far.
About Company: Helvar leads lighting intelligence to improve your well-being. We are an expert company in intelligent and energy efficient lighting solutions. Our extensive range of products, including lighting controls and luminaire components, can be used as single components or combined into lighting systems. Those lighting systems, next to improving energy efficiency, do enhance human comfort, mood and productivity.
name_zh: 谁还需要电灯开关？—— 自动化整个灯光控制流程
description_zh: 人们太懒了，不想手动控制灯光！帮助我们实现整个流程的自动化，或者至少为用户提供真正无缝的控制体验。通过寻找新方法，利用智能算法和/或最新传感器来提升人们的福祉，测试你的创新能力……
insights_zh:
为帮助你实现这一目标，我们将在智能房间中为你提供顶级的专业照明系统。我们的 REST API 可用于控制光照水平、色温、RGB 颜色和渐变时间。我们的 API 还为你提供来自各种传感器和输入设备的实时数据流：
 
 1. 光照强度传感器
 2. 照明系统中的任何按钮按下
 3. 被动红外（PIR）传感器
 4. 情绪戒指 http://www.moodmetric.com
 5. 红外摄像头 http://www.flir.com/cores/lepton/
 
 你也可以自由使用自己笔记本电脑或移动设备中的任何传感器
judging_criteria_zh:
1. 无需用户命令的自动且先进的照明控制。
 2. 通过从传感器数据中学习来优化照明系统。
 3. 新的用户界面，实现轻松控制照明。
prizes_zh: 一等奖：获胜团队将获得 Hubsan H501S 四轴飞行器（或同等产品）。荣誉奖：入选团队将获得 Amazon Echo Dot 设备。
links_zh: 获胜的主要标准是解决方案的创新性。结合这一点以及带有用例的精彩演示，你将走得很远。
about_company_zh: Helvar 引领照明智能，改善您的福祉。我们是一家专注于智能和节能照明解决方案的专家公司。我们广泛的产品系列，包括照明控制和灯具组件，既可作为单个组件使用，也可组合成照明系统。这些照明系统除了提高能源效率外，还能增强人体舒适度、情绪和生产力。

Challenge name: My perfect personal movie experience - Build the coolest enriched video experience app
Description:
Customers love to enjoy great movies from online video streaming services. However, finding the interesting thing to watch is not always simple or fun - that is why most people get their movie recommendations directly from friends. Googling around the internet to read reviews and top-lists is time consuming. There is a mass of information available about a movie but not in a convenient or enjoyable way. And once you have seen the great movie, you also might have a tempting need to know more about it or know what other people have said about it. Google or any social media is one way to find some of that information, but we think that it is not enough.
We challenge you to build a spectacular customer experience for finding interesting movies that match with my interests and desires right now or in the future, via social discussions and recommendations, and other information about the movie, such as the story, actors or making of the movie, from various sources in the internet. The experience should combine all relevant and valuable information about a movie or series in a cool and exciting way, so that it helps the user to make choices and dig deeper into the movie. You can enrich the discovery experience and user’s decision-making with for example social media comments, video clips, pictures, interviews, events, background information, and peer reviews. Think about deciding if you are going to watch a movie: What would you like to know about it? How should this information be provided to you inside the app so that it really adds value to you? 
Your solution should address one or more of the following user problems:
a)        How to find movies I like?
b)        How to plan my watching?
c)        How to discover what others are saying and take part in discussions?
As an outcome, we would like this customer frustration to be addressed: “As a user, I would like to easily explore and watch something that matches with my situation, mood and desires. I would like to know everything there is about the movie in a cool and exciting way. This helps me to decide if I am going to watch the movie or not. I can also find interesting additional information about the movie and see what other people are thinking about it. I can do all this in one application.”
Insights:
We will provide you with:
1.        A skeleton of video content browsing and playback mobile application
2.        A catalogue of movie titles with basic metadata (such as title name, title length, actors, genre, trailers, pictures, popularity) as well as the APIs to access this content
3.        List of valuable external information sources and APIs (social media, sites)
4.        On-site support and experts
5.        Smart TVs, VR glasses, game consoles, mobile devices
Resources: We will not provide you data about the user. So you will need to ask or find the data you need about the user, her preferences and desires in order to build the best ever movie experience.
Judging criteria: The user experience in the app with the enriched and visual movie related information is the key element here. Genuine ideas and enabling easy decision-making for the user are winning elements.  We are especially interested in finding solutions that do not just show the enriched data, but build value for the user on top of it.
Prizes: The prizes for the winning teams will be announced later.
Links: You can focus on one of the user problems deeply or solve all three of them (a-c). The app (on any device) also needs to work in real life. You do not need to use all the provided building elements (1-5). Additional ideas can also be presented even when not developed to the app, but you will not win just with great ideas. Solutions that build user value on top of the data is what we are after.
About Company: Elisa Viihde is all you need to feel entertained and Finland´s most popular multiscreen entertainment service. It serves more than 300 000 customers. Elisa is a telecommunications, ICT and online service company serving 2.3 million consumer, corporate and public administration organisation customers. Elisa provides environmentally sustainable services for communication and entertainment, and tools for organisations to digitalise their operations and improve productivity. In Finland, Elisa is the market leader in its field. In 2016, Elisa’s revenue was 1.64 billion euros, and the company employed 4,300 people.www.elisa.com
name_zh: 我的完美个人电影体验——打造最酷的增强视频体验应用
description_zh:
客户喜欢从在线视频流媒体服务中欣赏精彩电影。然而，找到有趣的内容观看并不总是简单或有趣的——这就是为什么大多数人直接从朋友那里获得电影推荐。在互联网上四处搜索以阅读评论和排行榜非常耗时。关于一部电影有大量信息可用，但并非以方便或愉快的方式呈现。而且一旦你看了一部好电影，你可能也会有一种强烈的需求，想要了解更多关于它的信息，或者知道别人对它的评价。谷歌或任何社交媒体是找到部分信息的一种方式，但我们认为这还不够。
我们挑战你打造一种壮观的客户体验，用于发现符合我当前或未来兴趣和愿望的有趣电影，通过社交讨论和推荐，以及关于电影的其他信息（如故事、演员或电影制作）从互联网的各种来源获取。该体验应以酷炫而令人兴奋的方式整合关于一部电影或剧集的所有相关且有价值的信息，从而帮助用户做出选择并深入探索电影。你可以通过例如社交媒体评论、视频片段、图片、采访、活动、背景信息和同行评论来丰富发现体验和用户的决策。思考一下决定是否要看一部电影时：你想了解它的哪些信息？这些信息应如何在应用内提供给你，才能真正为你增加价值？
你的解决方案应解决以下一个或多个用户问题：
a) 如何找到我喜欢的电影？
b) 如何规划我的观看？
c) 如何发现别人在说什么并参与讨论？
作为成果，我们希望解决以下客户痛点：“作为一个用户，我希望能够轻松探索并观看符合我当前情况、心情和愿望的内容。我希望以一种酷炫而令人兴奋的方式了解关于电影的一切。这帮助我决定是否要看这部电影。我还能找到关于电影的有趣附加信息，并看看别人对它的想法。我可以在一个应用中完成所有这些。”
insights_zh:
我们将为你提供：
1. 一个视频内容浏览和播放移动应用的骨架
2. 一个电影标题目录，包含基本元数据（如标题名称、时长、演员、类型、预告片、图片、流行度）以及访问此内容的API
3. 有价值的外部信息源和API列表（社交媒体、网站）
4. 现场支持和专家
5. 智能电视、VR眼镜、游戏主机、移动设备
judging_criteria_zh: 应用中丰富且可视化的电影相关信息的用户体验是关键要素。真正的创意和能够帮助用户轻松决策是获胜要素。我们特别感兴趣的是那些不仅展示丰富数据，还能在此基础上为用户创造价值的解决方案。
prizes_zh: 获胜团队的奖品将稍后公布。
resources_zh: 我们不会提供关于用户的数据。因此，你需要询问或找到你需要的关于用户、她的偏好和愿望的数据，以打造有史以来最佳的电影体验。
links_zh: 你可以深入聚焦于一个用户问题，或解决所有三个问题（a-c）。应用（在任何设备上）也需要在现实生活中运行。你不需要使用所有提供的构建元素（1-5）。额外的想法即使未开发到应用中也可以展示，但仅凭伟大的想法不会获胜。我们追求的是在数据之上构建用户价值的解决方案。
about_company_zh: Elisa Viihde 是您享受娱乐所需的一切，也是芬兰最受欢迎的多屏娱乐服务。它服务超过30万客户。Elisa 是一家电信、ICT和在线服务公司，服务于230万消费者、企业和公共管理组织客户。Elisa 提供环境可持续的通信和娱乐服务，以及帮助组织数字化运营和提高生产力的工具。在芬兰，Elisa 是其领域的市场领导者。2016年，Elisa 的收入为16.4亿欧元，公司拥有4300名员工。www.elisa.com

Challenge name: Reshaping the future of dental care. - Dive into the world of technology and use it to revolutionize dental care.
Description: Digital revolution is transforming the entire field of health care and patient care is no longer just taking care of the sick but preventing them from getting sick in the first place. For health care professionals new technology is a way to more efficient, more accurate and more comfortable care. Digital solutions can move the boundaries of health and dental care – the care pathway can start long before the visit to the clinic and go on long after. With advanced 3D imaging technology we can already create a precise digital twin of the patient, which raises a question whether we even need a visit to the dentist any longer?
Insights: To support the innovation process of the teams Planmeca will provide the participants with plenty of information regarding dental care industry and some of our existing solutions. Many of our equipment and solutions will be at the event for the participants to see and try out, including a dental care unit, 3D imaging device, intraoral scanner, and dental software. Participants will also have a chance to see and use real patient data in a form of a 3D virtual patient. Our mentors on site will coach participants and help them with any arising questions.
Resources: More details and sample data will be provided on Planmeca’s Junction website soon: www.planmeca.com/junction.
Judging criteria: We want to challenge people to think outside the box and expand the ideas of dental care into the digital world. There are two sides to this which we are especially interested in this particular challenge: the concept of a virtual clinic for patients and the virtual patient for clinics. \n\nHack into the patient experience and make it more effortless and less interruptive for the patient. On the other side of this, we want to give the dental care professionals tools for planning and preparing care without the patient being physically present, which improves the patient experience but also increases precision and accuracy of care.
Prizes: Prizes to be announced.
Links: Ultimately our mission is to make patient care better and safer by helping the health care professionals to make more accurate diagnoses and give their patients the best possible care. We want participants to embrace this mission, but throw away all limitations and think outside the box while doing so! The following criteria will be used to evaluate the performance and ideas of the teams: Creativity and originality, disruptiveness and feasibility for healthcare.
About Company: Planmeca Oy is one of the world's leading dental equipment manufacturers. Our products cover everything needed at a modern dental clinic – from digital dental units to CAD/CAM solutions, 2D and 3D imaging devices, and software. Our uncompromising dedication to innovation, collaboration with health care professionals and universities, and strong commitment to R&D are the cornerstones of our success. Our mission is to enable better patient care through revolutionary innovations.
name_zh: 重塑牙科护理的未来——深入技术世界，用技术革新牙科护理。
description_zh: 数字革命正在改变整个医疗保健领域，患者护理不再仅仅是治疗病患，而是从一开始就预防疾病。对于医疗保健专业人员来说，新技术是实现更高效、更准确、更舒适护理的途径。数字解决方案可以拓展健康和牙科护理的边界——护理路径可以在就诊前很久就开始，并在就诊后持续很久。借助先进的三维成像技术，我们已经可以创建患者的精确数字孪生，这引发了一个问题：我们是否还需要去看牙医？
insights_zh: 为了支持团队的创新过程，Planmeca 将向参与者提供大量关于牙科护理行业和我们现有解决方案的信息。我们的许多设备和解决方案将在活动现场供参与者查看和试用，包括牙科护理单元、三维成像设备、口内扫描仪和牙科软件。参与者还将有机会以三维虚拟患者的形式查看和使用真实患者数据。现场的导师将指导参与者，并帮助他们解决任何问题。
judging_criteria_zh:
我们希望挑战人们跳出框框思考，将牙科护理的理念扩展到数字世界。我们对此特定挑战特别感兴趣的有两个方面：面向患者的虚拟诊所概念和面向诊所的虚拟患者。

深入患者体验，让患者感受更轻松、更少干扰。另一方面，我们希望为牙科护理专业人员提供工具，以便在患者不在场的情况下规划和准备护理，这不仅能改善患者体验，还能提高护理的精确度和准确性。
prizes_zh: 奖项待公布。
resources_zh: 更多详细信息和样本数据将很快在 Planmeca 的 Junction 网站上提供：www.planmeca.com/junction。
links_zh: 最终，我们的使命是通过帮助医疗保健专业人员做出更准确的诊断并为患者提供最佳可能的护理，使患者护理更好、更安全。我们希望参与者拥抱这一使命，但在这样做时抛弃所有限制，跳出框框思考！以下标准将用于评估团队的表现和想法：创造力和原创性、颠覆性以及医疗保健可行性。
about_company_zh: Planmeca Oy 是全球领先的牙科设备制造商之一。我们的产品涵盖现代牙科诊所所需的一切——从数字牙科单元到 CAD/CAM 解决方案、二维和三维成像设备以及软件。我们对创新的不懈追求、与医疗保健专业人员和大学的合作以及对研发的坚定承诺是我们成功的基石。我们的使命是通过革命性创新实现更好的患者护理。

Challenge name: Cross Platform for Desktop and Embedded - Create the User Experience of a lifetime on multiple platforms.
Description: Create fluid, high-performance and intuitive UIs, applications, and embedded devices – with the same code base for all platforms. In our homes, our cars, our workplaces and our pockets smart devices are everywhere. Qt makes sure you can create unique & modern connected devices that stand out from the crowd.
Insights: You can download Qt before the event from http://qt.io \nTo the event we will bring a bunch of Raspberry Pi boards and the necessary bits and pieces to get them running.\nYou can choose the APIs you connect to.
Resources:
You can find a lot of resources and help to Qt at for instance:
- http://doc.qt.io
- http://forum.qt.io
and other qt.io sites
Judging criteria: Qt is much more than just a cross-platform SDK - it's a technology strategy that lets you quickly and cost-effectively design, develop, deploy, and maintain software while delivering a seamless user experience across all devices.
Prizes: The prize for this challenge is a license to the full Qt developer licenese. Other prizes will be revealed at a later date, follow this space!
Links: Our developers and specialists judging the solutions will focus on the innovative use of Qt, the overall User Experience and Qt is used to connect different pieces of information.
About Company:
The Qt Company is responsible for Qt development, 
productization and licensing under commercial and 
open-source licenses. Qt is a C++ based framework of 
libraries and tools that enables the development of powerful, interactive and cross-platform applications and devices.

description_zh: 创建流畅、高性能且直观的UI、应用程序和嵌入式设备——所有平台使用同一套代码库。在我们的家庭、汽车、工作场所和口袋中，智能设备无处不在。Qt确保您可以创建独特且现代的联网设备，在众多产品中脱颖而出。

Challenge name: Play Beautiful - Coach gamers to excellence!
Description: Competitive gaming is now larger than the NBA and NHL combined. Be part of this new branch of entertainment and help us leverage real-time data streams to provide gameplay analytics for both amateurs and professional gamers alike. Build upon these analytics to provide advanced tactical and strategical coaching advice or groundbreaking insight.
Insights: You'll have access to real gameplay data from the gripping multiplayer PC game, team-based military experience, Squad. The data will be available as a real-time Kafka stream, as well as a static archive queryable from old-school MySQL. The data provides in-game coordinates, view angles, movement information, shooting events, damage indicators, and so on. In addition we provide Steam game keys and the entire set of game assets, such as the maps, weaponry, and any other the game specific information.\n\nWe are bringing mentors with years of experience in PC gaming and in developing AI/big data/web based solutions.
Judging criteria: With this challenge we wish to help gamers build their skills and reach their peak performance. Help us unlock insights in individual player game behaviors.
Prizes: Each member of the winning team receives a HyperX Cloud II Gaming Headset, €100 Steam Gift Voucher (or equivalent for non-gamers), and a Kamu office tour with a Kamu team dinner.\nIn addition, selected teams get a Kamu office tour with an exclusive, catered social event.
Links: We focus on impact, utility, and beauty. We're looking for innovative ideas that will enhance the game experience for gamers worldwide.We focus on impact, utility, and beauty. We're looking for innovative ideas that will enhance the game experience for gamers worldwide.
About Company: Kamu provides the leading game security solution, EasyAntiCheat. We exist to keep gameplay fair and fun, accelerate game development and help gamers sharpen their skills by providing category defining services & tools in the fields of game security, gameplay analytics and game management. We welcome all developers and designers, and are open to continued collaboration with the teams after Junction.
name_zh: 玩出精彩——助玩家成就卓越！
description_zh: 竞技游戏如今已超越NBA和NHL的总和。加入这一新兴娱乐分支，帮助我们利用实时数据流，为业余和专业玩家提供游戏分析。基于这些分析，提供先进的战术和战略指导建议或突破性见解。
insights_zh:
您将获得来自引人入胜的多人在线PC游戏《Squad》的真实游戏数据，这是一款基于团队的军事体验游戏。数据将以实时Kafka流的形式提供，同时也可通过传统的MySQL查询静态存档。数据提供游戏内坐标、视角、移动信息、射击事件、伤害指示等。此外，我们还提供Steam游戏密钥和全套游戏资产，如地图、武器以及任何其他游戏特定信息。

我们邀请了拥有多年PC游戏经验以及开发AI/大数据/基于网络解决方案的导师。
judging_criteria_zh: 通过这一挑战，我们希望帮助玩家提升技能并达到巅峰表现。帮助我们揭示个体玩家游戏行为中的洞见。
prizes_zh:
获胜团队的每位成员将获得HyperX Cloud II游戏耳机、100欧元Steam礼品券（或非游戏玩家的等值奖品），以及Kamu办公室参观和Kamu团队晚餐。
此外，入选团队将获得Kamu办公室参观和独家 catered 社交活动。
links_zh: 我们关注影响力、实用性和美观性。我们正在寻找能够增强全球玩家游戏体验的创新想法。我们关注影响力、实用性和美观性。我们正在寻找能够增强全球玩家游戏体验的创新想法。
about_company_zh: Kamu提供领先的游戏安全解决方案EasyAntiCheat。我们的存在是为了保持游戏公平和有趣，加速游戏开发，并通过在游戏安全、游戏分析和游戏管理领域提供品类定义的服务和工具，帮助玩家提升技能。我们欢迎所有开发者和设计师，并在Junction之后愿意与团队继续合作。

Challenge name: Transform the way the world builds! - Create the next big thing in digitalizing the building industry.
Description: We live in a 3D world, and we need to handle lots of 3D data in our business. The challenge is the journey from reality to digital and back to existing world. Have you ever measured your house or organized the furniture virtually using your phone? Now is the chance to put your fire into creating groundbreaking applications using 3D modelling, images, machine learning, sensors, augmented/virtual reality, voice recognition or whatever that makes things magical. Beam me up, Scotty!
Insights: During the event Trimble technologies are available for the participants. For example, Tekla Structures, SketchUp, 3D Warehouse, Trimble Connect and other Trimble tools.\n\nWe will bring Microsoft HoloLenses and AR/VR gear into our track area.

– Innovative idea
– Technical implementation and design
– Business potential
- But most of all - collaborate, have fun and tell a captivating story
Prizes: TBATBA

From purpose built products to enterprise lifecycle solutions, Trimble software, hardware and services are transforming a broad range of industries such as agriculture, construction, geospatial and transportation and logistics.

description_zh: 我们生活在一个三维世界中，业务中需要处理大量3D数据。挑战在于从现实到数字，再回到现有世界的旅程。你是否曾用手机测量过你的房子或虚拟布置家具？现在有机会让你全力以赴，利用3D建模、图像、机器学习、传感器、增强/虚拟现实、语音识别或任何能创造神奇效果的技术，打造突破性的应用。把我传送上去吧，Scotty！

Challenge name: Facial Recognition for Everyone - Create an app using one or multiple of TrueFace.ai facial recognition APIs
Description: Facial recognition is taking over. Even Apple is part of it now! From paying with your face, authenticating with your face, detecting emotions, detecting face characteristics, surveillance, automatic check-in and much more, the use cases are endless.\n\nTake part in this and apply your own application of our deep learning powered facial recognition.
Insights:
Participants will create inventive, valuable and impressive applications using one or a combination of:

Face Detect (detect 1 or more faces in an image)

Face Match (match 1 face against a database of faces - e.g. can be used as a replacement for login)

Face Identify (identify 1 or many faces - e.g. can be used to identify individuals in a crowd)

Raw Landmark detection (identify the facial characteristics, e.g. can be used to recommend a type of glasses based on face shape)

Spoof detection (detect when there is an attack, i.e. someone is trying to trick the technology by holding up a photo of someone else)

We will provide slack and email support during the event, for both the technical and non-technical side of things.
Resources: API Documentation: https://getchui.github.io/chuiaidocs/#introduction\n\nFor any questions join our Slack channel - https://join.slack.com/t/truefaceaicommunity/shared_invite/MjM4MTE3NDgxMTg2LTE1MDQ4NjM0NzEtNzQ4ZTczZTNjNQ
Judging criteria: Impress us with the creativity, originality, quality and use of your application using TrueFace.ai technology
Prizes: A Chui device for each member of the winning team. It is a facial recognition security system (can be used as a smart doorbell or access control system) that is managed from the application.A Chui device for each member of the winning team. description_zh:

参与其中，应用我们深度学习驱动的人脸识别技术，打造你自己的应用。
insights_zh:
参与者将使用以下一项或多项组合，创建富有创意、有价值且令人印象深刻的应用：

Challenge name: Sitra wellness challenge - Mix, shake, twist and present wellness data in an intuitive and clever form using the latest data lake technologies and analytics.
Description: Your team will have an Azure data lake set up with two separate data sets: 1)  synthetic health data and 2) sensor data combining wellness data and data from IoT sensors. Your task is to build an application which either present parts of this data in a clever new way, to interact with the data or brings more real-time data using sensors or social media to the data lake. You have all the flexibility to be creative as long as your solution uses the given technologies and has potential to increase wellness.
Insights: Before the event we will publish the meta data of the datasets which will be uploaded to the datalake. During the event you will have technical support to use the datalake and analytics tools as well as support for the datasets.
Resources: The links to the supporting material will be published shortly.
Judging criteria: Artificial intelligence and the use of big data will revolutionize healthcare as we know it. In our challenge you could do for example data visualizations, unsupervised clustering, supervised machine learning, data profiling or secure data directory for medical research.

name_zh: Sitra 健康挑战 - 利用最新数据湖技术和分析，以直观巧妙的形式混合、摇动、扭转并呈现健康数据。
description_zh: 你的团队将获得一个 Azure 数据湖，其中包含两个独立的数据集：1) 合成健康数据；2) 结合健康数据和来自 IoT 传感器的数据的传感器数据。你的任务是构建一个应用程序，以巧妙的新方式呈现部分数据、与数据交互，或者使用传感器或社交媒体将更多实时数据带入数据湖。只要你的解决方案使用了给定的技术并具有提升健康的潜力，你可以自由发挥创造力。
insights_zh: 活动前，我们将发布将上传到数据湖的数据集的元数据。活动期间，你将获得使用数据湖和分析工具的技术支持，以及数据集的支持。
judging_criteria_zh: 人工智能和大数据的使用将彻底改变我们所熟知的医疗保健。在我们的挑战中，你可以进行例如数据可视化、无监督聚类、监督机器学习、数据剖析或用于医学研究的安全数据目录。

Challenge name: Small choice today, big impact tomorrow - Understanding the effect of our choices towards a sustainable metals industry
Description:
Mankind is exceeding Earth´s natural resource budget earlier and earlier every year. This means our current footprint on the planet is too heavy. We believe people will make wiser decisions, if they only had the relevant information available. At the same time massive amounts of open data sources are available from single satellites to social media and ethnographic information. How could we use this data to facilitate more sustainable choices?

Key focus area
Design a concept, tool or application to demonstrate the environmental footprint and social impact of producing, selecting and using materials.
Insights: Our process technology expertise, mentors to help you \nMaterial footprint data and how these materials are produced, where, and how different processing technologies affect the footprint\nUseful open data sources that can be used as a reference when putting bits and pieces of information together
Prizes: Winning team members will each get electric bikes. Smaller rewards will be given to outstanding ideas.Winning team members will each get electric bikes. Smaller rewards will be given to outstanding ideas.
Links: To win this challenge make an impact! Introduce a solution that helps to make more sustainable decisions in our everyday lives. We are looking for practical and scalable solutions that bring transparency into material selections, logistics, manufacturing methods or similar aspects. To win this challenge make an impact! Introduce a solution that helps to make more sustainable decisions in our everyday lives. We are looking for practical and scalable solutions that bring transparency into material selections, logistics, manufacturing methods or similar aspects.
About Company: At Outotec our mission is to help our customers create the smartest value from natural resources and working together with them to find the most sustainable solutions for water, energy, minerals, and for handling the full value chain from ore to metals. We are dedicated to developing and delivering sustainable technology solutions and life-cycle services for our customers. Sustainability is at the very core of everything we do.
name_zh: 今天的小选择，明天的大影响——理解我们的选择对可持续金属行业的影响
description_zh:
人类每年越来越早地超出地球的自然资源预算。这意味着我们当前对地球的足迹过于沉重。我们相信，如果人们能够获得相关信息，就会做出更明智的决定。同时，从单个卫星到社交媒体和民族志信息，大量开放数据源可供使用。我们如何利用这些数据来促进更可持续的选择？

关键焦点领域
设计一个概念、工具或应用程序，以展示生产、选择和使用材料的环境足迹和社会影响。
insights_zh:
我们的工艺技术专业知识，导师为您提供帮助
材料足迹数据以及这些材料如何生产、在哪里生产，以及不同加工技术如何影响足迹

Challenge name: Banking reimagined - Dazzle the markets using our banking APIs
Description: The banking industry is undergoing radical change. New technology, new market players, and new regulation are disrupting a traditional and uninspired industry. One of these changes, the revised Payment Service Directive (PSD2), forces banks to allow their customers to control how they want to access their accounts. We want to go beyond what the regulation states, as we see it having far-reaching consequences in ways that we could not even dream of. That’s where you come in. Use our banking APIs and other technologies out there to create an app that will dazzle the markets.
Insights: Participating teams will receive access to the Nordea Open Banking developer portal, which contains the API documentation and sandbox. \n\nWe will also have our developers and banking industry experts present at the event for any advice and mentoring you may need.
Resources: More information on Open Banking and PSD2 can be found here: https://medium.com/@NordeaOpenBanking/open-banking-the-perfect-storm-to-shake-up-banking-as-we-know-it-2d05d37efb1
Judging criteria:
What you create is completely up to you, but we have outlined some areas that may offer you some inspiration:

1. Turning old and traditional into interactive and intelligent
What comes into your mind when you think of Life insurance? Boring, confusing, complicated? Maybe currently this is the case, but the future is wide open. This is where we feel you can actually make a difference by utilising your expertise in order to make life insurance more interactive and intelligent. For us, being more interactive and intelligent means increasing the customer value and finding new ways of communicating it.  
Think what kind of data or technology you could use, and apply to make life insurance more interactive. How could your solution decrease the customer pains and enhance the gains? What is the one thing that you would like to remove/resolve/change if you were responsible for the insurance services of the future? We know that activity based life insurance (i.e.Vitality) is already yesterday's news - what could be the next big thing?
 
2. Making saving and investments more personal
As the world becomes increasingly digitalised, the expectation of speed, relevance, simplicity, and proactive outreach increases. People buy their clothes, pay their bills, get entertained, guided and advised in digital channels, while the amount of traditional face-to-face interactions are decreasing. This is true also for our customers. However, in a world with an ever increasing amount of options, the need for personalised advice and the desire for relevant information grow, and at the same time it needs to be delivered in more inspiring ways than we are used to.
Come up with an interactive and inspiring solution for how to create engagement, increase knowledge, interest and willingness to save and at the same time entertain!
Prizes:
Winner: 2000€ gift card to amazon or verkkokauppa and a chance to meet the Chief Digital Officer of Nordea or the CEO of Nordea Life & Pension FI to exchange ideas and discuss future opportunities. 

Runner up: 1000€ gift card to amazon or verkkokauppa. Winner: 2000€ gift card to amazon or verkkokauppa and a chance to meet the Chief Digital Officer of Nordea or the CEO of Nordea Life & Pension FI to exchange ideas and discuss future opportunities.

name_zh: 重新构想银行业 - 用我们的银行API惊艳市场
description_zh: 银行业正在经历彻底变革。新技术、新市场参与者和新法规正在颠覆一个传统且缺乏创新的行业。其中一项变化，即修订后的支付服务指令（PSD2），迫使银行允许客户控制他们访问账户的方式。我们希望超越法规的要求，因为我们看到它会产生深远的影响，甚至超出我们最疯狂的想象。这就是你需要发挥作用的地方。使用我们的银行API和其他现有技术，创建一个能够惊艳市场的应用。

我们还将有开发人员和银行业专家出席活动，提供您可能需要的任何建议和指导。
judging_criteria_zh:
您创建的内容完全由您决定，但我们列出了一些可能为您提供灵感的领域：

1. 将传统和陈旧变为互动和智能
当您想到人寿保险时，会想到什么？无聊、困惑、复杂？也许目前确实如此，但未来是广阔的。我们认为您可以通过利用自己的专业知识，使人寿保险更加互动和智能，从而真正有所作为。对我们来说，更加互动和智能意味着增加客户价值并找到新的沟通方式。
想想您可以使用什么样的数据或技术，并应用它使人寿保险更加互动。您的解决方案如何减少客户痛点并增强收益？如果您负责未来的保险服务，您最想移除/解决/改变的一件事是什么？我们知道基于活动的人寿保险（即Vitality）已经是昨日新闻——下一个大事件可能是什么？

2. 让储蓄和投资更加个性化
随着世界日益数字化，对速度、相关性、简单性和主动外联的期望不断增加。人们在数字渠道中购买衣服、支付账单、获得娱乐、指导和咨询，而传统的面对面互动数量正在减少。对我们的客户来说也是如此。然而，在一个选择日益增多的世界中，对个性化建议的需求和对相关信息的渴望也在增长，同时需要以比我们习惯的更具启发性的方式传递。
提出一个互动且鼓舞人心的解决方案，如何创造参与度、增加知识、兴趣和储蓄意愿，同时提供娱乐！

Challenge name: Store smarter - Is there intelligent life in your space?
Description:
Do you have a storage space in your basement or in the attic? Do you remember what is in there? Nowadays we own so many things, and for many of us the experience of trying to organize our private or work stuff is challenging. The problem is that many times we don’t remember what we have, or we don’t know where those things are, or if it is still even usable. 

Sound familiar? Then why not help us come up with a smart storage space!
You can think of solving these problems, either for a
1)	Residential building (private storage space) or
2)	School, hospital, library or other public building (public storage spaces)

What would your smart storage space look like? Would it help reduce waste (like recycling or reuse)? Or keep track of and optimize the value of your items? Help in optimizing general warehouse management?
Insights:
RFID tags and reader(s), antennas and instructions how to use them and fetch the data from tags.
You will also have real storage space items to play around with. 

You can also discuss and get support from both Stora Enso team (business and tech) and Siili team (tech and design). We will also provide you with more info about Stora Enso products and technology that is used already. Siili mentors will help and spar your team in tech and design related matters.
Judging criteria:
Some ideas to start your creative thinking

1)	Tracking/inventory system to find your stuff easily by using some device
2)	Get yourself (online) connected to your storage space and to your things
3)	Managing the space by using sensor technology and/or image/voice recognition…
4)	Creative solutions for reutilization/recycling/sharing of stored items
Prizes: The winning team will be awarded with a journey to a European capital, including some Smart City experience and a visit to a Stora Enso manufacturing unit of smart building components. The second team will get to attend a free-of-choice course at Siili Adacemy.The winning team will be awarded with a journey to a European capital, including some Smart City experience and a visit to a Stora Enso manufacturing unit of smart building components. name_zh: 更智能地存储——你的空间里有智能生命吗？
description_zh:
你的地下室或阁楼里有储物空间吗？你还记得里面放了什么吗？如今我们拥有的物品如此之多，对我们许多人来说，尝试整理私人或工作物品的经历颇具挑战性。问题在于，很多时候我们不记得自己拥有什么，或者不知道那些东西放在哪里，甚至不知道它们是否还能使用。

听起来很熟悉？那么，为什么不帮助我们构思一个智能储物空间呢！
你可以考虑解决这些问题，针对以下两种场景之一：
1）住宅楼（私人储物空间），或
2）学校、医院、图书馆或其他公共建筑（公共储物空间）

你的智能储物空间会是什么样子？它会有助于减少浪费（比如回收或再利用）吗？还是能跟踪并优化你物品的价值？有助于优化整体仓库管理吗？
insights_zh:
RFID标签和读写器、天线以及如何使用它们并从标签获取数据的说明。
你还将拥有真实的储物空间物品可供操作。

你也可以与Stora Enso团队（业务和技术）以及Siili团队（技术和设计）讨论并获得支持。我们还将为你提供更多关于Stora Enso产品及已在使用中的技术的信息。Siili导师将在技术和设计相关事务上帮助并启发你的团队。
judging_criteria_zh:
一些激发你创造性思维的起点想法：

1）跟踪/库存系统，通过某种设备轻松找到你的物品
2）让你（在线）连接到你的储物空间和你的物品
3）利用传感器技术和/或图像/语音识别来管理空间……
4）针对存储物品的再利用/回收/共享的创造性解决方案

Challenge name: Microservices For Fintech - Develop a small service in the space of Financial Technology
Description:
A Financial Service has a lot of moving parts, and what the customer sees is just the tip of the Iceberg. 

While it may appear that a fintech is a single company, it is in fact a group of services that compound the end product. These components are very often startups themselves: Identity verification, Authentication, Operations, Marketing tools, Monitoring, money management, payment methods… and we’re just starting.

We want you to focus on any small service that is part of the FinTech ecosystem, and build something cool. With the technologies you want, with the API’s that you like the most.
Insights:
Holvi will provide mentorship and support in all corners of a fintech:

- Financial Systems (accounting, money management)
- Operations (Identification, monitoring)
- Customer Support
- Compliance, Risk, fraud and Anti Money Laundering management
- Product and Design

We will also provide a cluster for you to deploy and test your microservice. You just have to use Docker and any other technology you prefer.
Resources: To be provided soon.
Judging criteria: Match peer to peer lenders, alleviate the registration process, reduce fraud, helping a bank back office to be agile, provide advices to customers on your financial life... All these topics are open for hacking !\n\nAlso, with PSD2 Disruption, all banks will have an api by 2018. What will you do with it?

800 - Most Disruptive

- 金融系统（会计、资金管理）

- 客户支持

Challenge name: Most Creative Use of the Spotify Platform - Create the most creative project using the Spotify Platform.
Description: We’re Spotify. We love to enable creativity - whether that’s millions of creators, 140 million users or the ∞ of developers. We love to keep things simple. All we look for is the most creative use of the Spotify Platform - and we can’t wait to see how the Spotify Platform can promote such creativity.
Insights:
We’re Spotify. We bringing over 140 million users the right music for the right moment - on computers, mobiles, tablets, home entertainment systems, cars, gaming consoles and more.

Well, in true Spotify style, we’ll keep the challenge simple: Most Creative Use of the Spotify Platform.

We encourage you to think outside the box. Use technology to build something creative for the millions of inspired music lovers all over the world using Spotify every single day.
Resources: https://developer.spotify.com/junction-2017/
Judging criteria:
Creativity is what we care about most.

Some example projects built on the Spotify Platform include:
Mangomoji (https://twitter.com/SpotifyPlatform/status/914523577612894208): How about using emojis to help you discover music?
SDOKW (https://developer.spotify.com/showcase/item/six-degrees-kanye-west/): How many degrees of separation between Kanye West and your favourite artist?
DDDJ (https://twitter.com/SpotifyPlatform/status/914530772412968960): How about generating playlists by reverse engineering into a physical DJ controller?
Musixmatch (https://developer.spotify.com/showcase/item/musixmatch/): How about showing you lyrics in real-time based on the Spotify client?

There’s a lot more in our developer showcase (https://developer.spotify.com/showcase/). We recommend checking out the Full Track Audio Analysis (https://developer.spotify.com/web-api/get-audio-analysis/) and Audio Features API (https://developer.spotify.com/web-api/get-audio-features/) endpoints, they’re the most exciting for sure!
Prizes: There’s Patchblocks module x 4 (one for each team member) for the winning team!There’s Patchblocks module x 4 (one for each team member) for the winning team!

about_company_zh: 我们是 Spotify。我们为超过 1.4 亿用户带来适合正确时刻的正确音乐——在电脑、手机、平板、家庭娱乐系统、汽车、游戏主机等设备上。通过 Spotify 平台，我们提供优秀的 API 和 SDK——例如元数据、播放、分析和 Spotify Connect——因为我们关心激发创造力，从创作者到用户再到开发者。我们迫不及待想看到今年 Junction 会涌现出什么样的创造力。

Challenge name: Hit the Jackpot! - Create a new online sports game with our sports data.
Description: What does a footballer think, when she’s running on the pitch, her eyes fixed on the ball? When the adrenaline pulses through ice-hockey players veins, and he knows that it’s up to his skills and tactics to score a goal? Or tennis-player serves an ace?\n\nWe challenge you to create a new sports-themed online game! Imagine how you would like to hit the jackpot? We will give you a massive amount of our sports data and statistics as well as help from our experts to add excitement to your game. Your game can be optimized for desktop, for mobile or for all devices. You decide what determines the player’s success in the game – is it based on chance, skills or both?
Insights: We will bring a massive amount of our sports data and statistics as well as mentors to help with technical questions.
Judging criteria: Criteria for winning is to create an innovative sports game which has potential to become a new gaming product for Veikkaus. The game should hold intriguing logics but still be easy to understand. The visual experience would preferably inspire adults to play the game. We hope to see that the unique business model of Veikkaus is understood in your solutions.
About Company:
Veikkaus – we are a Finnish gaming company with a special mission. We offer entertaining and safe gaming experiences and take gaming-related detriments seriously. 

Veikkaus generates over one billion euros a year for the common good. We are the workplace to ca. 2,000 gaming industry professionals and welcome all developers and digital enthusiasts to further develop our gaming world and share their expertise in Junction.  

We have nearly 4,000 gaming locations and playing arcades, and we hold the exclusive right for gambling in Finland.
name_zh: 赢取大奖！——用我们的体育数据打造一款全新在线体育游戏
description_zh:
当一名足球运动员在球场上奔跑、目光紧盯着球时，她在想什么？当肾上腺素在冰球运动员的血管中奔涌，他知道进球全靠自己的技巧和战术时，他又在想什么？或者网球选手发出一记 Ace 球时呢？

我们挑战你打造一款全新的体育主题在线游戏！想象一下，你希望如何赢取大奖？我们将为你提供海量的体育数据和统计数据，以及我们专家的帮助，为你的游戏增添刺激。你的游戏可以针对桌面端、移动端或所有设备进行优化。玩家在游戏中的成功取决于什么——是运气、技巧，还是两者兼有？由你决定。
insights_zh: 我们将提供海量的体育数据和统计数据，并安排导师协助解决技术问题。
judging_criteria_zh: 获胜标准是打造一款创新的体育游戏，并具备成为 Veikkaus 新游戏产品的潜力。游戏应具有引人入胜的逻辑，同时仍易于理解。视觉体验最好能激发成年人的游玩兴趣。我们希望看到你的解决方案能够理解 Veikkaus 独特的商业模式。
about_company_zh:
Veikkaus——我们是一家肩负特殊使命的芬兰游戏公司。我们提供有趣且安全的游戏体验，并严肃对待与游戏相关的危害。

Veikkaus 每年为公益事业创造超过十亿欧元的收入。我们是约 2,000 名游戏行业专业人士的工作场所，欢迎所有开发者和数字爱好者进一步开发我们的游戏世界，并在 Junction 分享他们的专业知识。

我们拥有近 4,000 个游戏网点和游乐场，并持有芬兰的独家博彩经营权。

Description: We would like you to develop an easy-to-use, creative, and exciting game with any technology available that helps us develop solutions around gamification of People Flow.  \nBut first, what is our business? We are in the business of moving 1 billion people everyday or as we call it providing safe, reliable and convenient ‘People Flow’. Our products and solutions are elevators, escalators, electric doors, and our Advanced People Flow solutions such as KONE Access, KONE Residential Flow, Infotainments to name a few. Who are our customers? Our customers are architects, real estate developers, construction and facility management companies. KONE equipment and services support people flow in various building domains such as office and residential buildings, airports, metro stations, shopping malls, hospitals and hotels.
description_zh:
我们希望您利用任何可用技术，开发一款易于使用、富有创意且令人兴奋的游戏，帮助我们围绕客流游戏化开发解决方案。
但首先，我们的业务是什么？我们每天运送10亿人，或者如我们所说，提供安全、可靠和便捷的“客流”。我们的产品和解决方案包括电梯、自动扶梯、电动门，以及我们的高级客流解决方案，例如KONE Access、KONE Residential Flow、信息娱乐系统等。我们的客户是谁？我们的客户是建筑师、房地产开发商、建筑和设施管理公司。通力设备和服务支持各种建筑领域的人员流动，例如办公楼和住宅楼、机场、地铁站、购物中心、医院和酒店。

Challenge name: I hear voices in my factory
Description: There is a factory, far far away from Junction, producing valuable metals to meet our everyday needs. This is a complex process requiring tremendous amounts of energy and blistering temperatures in which things can go wrong with the potential of damage to people and equipment. Based on the provided audio and motion data and failure events, can you diagnose how the factory operates and predict future failures, or prevent them? Can you visualise the data so that it speaks to the operators to help guide them safely? We do not know if there is even any correlation between the data and failures (in theory there should be), so we value a good try and clever new ways for digesting and visualising the data. Make the factory a safer place to work!
description_zh: 在远离Junction的某个地方，有一座工厂，生产着我们日常所需的贵重金属。这是一个复杂的过程，需要消耗大量能源并处于极高温度下，其中可能出现问题，有可能对人员和设备造成损害。基于提供的音频和运动数据以及故障事件，您能否诊断工厂的运行状况，并预测未来的故障，或者预防它们？您能否将数据可视化，使其能够向操作员传达信息，帮助安全地指导他们？我们甚至不知道数据与故障之间是否存在任何关联（理论上应该存在），因此我们重视良好的尝试以及处理和可视化数据的巧妙新方法。让工厂成为更安全的工作场所！

Description: John and Jane are process operators working in a remote factory away from the big city lights. The process is mostly automated but human presence is still needed for monitoring that the process goes smooth and to quickly react in case something unexpected happens. John and Jane are sitting in a cozy, air conditioned control room and currently working for the third night in a row. As usual, information flickers across the screen with occasional alarms blinking in displays like lights in a Christmas tree, but apart from that John and Jane feel sleepy and bored. Losing focus can be dangerous and according to studies 70 % of often very costly failures are caused by a human error. How can you make John’s and Jane’s work more exciting, engaging and smoother by using gamification/UX/AR/VR/AI/younameit methods?
description_zh: John和Jane是远离大城市灯光的偏远工厂的流程操作员。流程大部分是自动化的，但仍需要人工在场监控流程是否顺利进行，并在发生意外情况时快速反应。John和Jane坐在舒适、有空调的控制室里，目前已经连续第三个晚上工作。像往常一样，信息在屏幕上闪烁，偶尔的警报在显示器上闪烁，就像圣诞树上的灯光，但除此之外，John和Jane感到困倦和无聊。失去注意力可能是危险的，根据研究，70%的通常非常昂贵的故障是由人为错误造成的。你如何通过使用游戏化/UX/AR/VR/AI/你说了算的方法，让John和Jane的工作更令人兴奋、更投入、更顺畅？

Description: How smart can your building be? How can you control the lighting in a building to boost mood and productivity? Can this brain-driven building  optimise the indoor environment automatically, detect possible defects and abnormalities and compensate for them? How can machine learning and AI be used to do this? What can you tell about building usage and status using the power of data.\nMany of the public buildings are equipped with a wide variety of systems controlling the environment of the building such as ventilation, lighting etc. These systems are working individually without exchanging information outside its system but they are collecting data that can be utilized more broadly and can be used as basis for totally new data driven services. Especially the lighting control systems are collecting data of the people’s movement in the building. By applying suitable AI algorithms you can create a totally new BRAIN of the building which combines data from different sources beyond lighting control purposes.
description_zh:
你的建筑能有多智能？如何通过控制建筑内的照明来提升情绪和生产力？这种由大脑驱动的建筑能否自动优化室内环境、检测可能的缺陷和异常并进行补偿？如何利用机器学习和人工智能来实现这一点？借助数据的力量，你能对建筑的使用情况和状态得出哪些洞察？
许多公共建筑配备了各种控制系统来调节建筑环境，如通风、照明等。这些系统各自独立运行，不与系统外部交换信息，但它们正在收集可被更广泛利用的数据，并可作为全新数据驱动服务的基础。特别是照明控制系统正在收集建筑内人员移动的数据。通过应用合适的AI算法，你可以创建一个全新的建筑“大脑”，它能够整合来自不同来源的数据，超越照明控制的目的。

Challenge name: Smart Traffic - From Predictions to Real Time
Description: The challenge is to come up with an idea of a smart mobility solution. The solution can be related for example to smart tram, including autonomous buses as last mile solution, and should ultimately improve everyday life of the people on that area and motivate them towards sustainable modes of transport. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dvMD2jry_18&t=16s
name_zh: 智能交通 - 从预测到实时
description_zh: 挑战在于提出一个智能出行解决方案的想法。该解决方案可以例如与智能有轨电车相关，包括作为最后一英里解决方案的自动驾驶巴士，并最终应改善该地区人们的日常生活，并激励他们采用可持续的交通方式。https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dvMD2jry_18&t=16s

Challenge name: Towards the New Generation of Guidance
Description: The City needs new guidance solutions to make guiding and finding services easier. Ideally, solutions will be based on specific data on how people move, hence the challenge includes how to get better understanding of how people are moving, by using innovative solutions and possibly combining different data sources. It is important to use gained information in developing guiding solutions such as the city info screens, in most challenging areas and situations.  At the same time, the target is to guide people towards sustainable modes of transport.
description_zh: 坦佩雷市需要新的引导解决方案，使引导和查找服务更加便捷。理想情况下，解决方案应基于人们出行的具体数据，因此挑战包括如何通过创新解决方案并可能结合不同数据源来更好地理解人们的出行方式。重要的是，将获取的信息用于开发引导解决方案，例如在城市信息屏幕中，应用于最具挑战性的区域和场景。同时，目标是引导人们采用可持续的交通方式。

Description:
Something is happening around us:
Freedom is one of the most valued things in life nowadays.
Digital transformation is changing the game of traffic systems globally
New technologies like e-cars, Hyperloop and AI will set the new standard level for traffic systems and freedom of people.
Attention revolution around traffic and climate change is becoming more and more clear and is actually happening right now
But the traffic system around us is old and broken: own a car, buy expensive bus tickets, find a gas station or choose unsure waiting times.
Salo is like Finland in a mini size: sea views, hundreds of lakes, a beautiful national park, space and peace to live. It’s like the photos  you see in your Instagram feed: Yes, it is that cool. In addition, the mobile phone revolution started from Salo: you know Nokia.
Now we are building the next revolution. We challenge you to innovate a revolutionary never stopping traffic system which will maximize the freedom to live for people, and at the same time minimize the harms of traffic for the environment. We already have inductive charging, e-cars and data. How we can build the most advanced ”never stopping traffic system” which is scalable all over the globe? We know that Salo is the optimal place for testing, because of our awesome people and flexible business environment. The challenge is to show us how this could be done!
description_zh:
我们周围正在发生一些事情：
如今，自由是生活中最受珍视的事物之一。
数字化转型正在改变全球交通系统的格局。
电动汽车、Hyperloop和AI等新技术将为交通系统和人们的自由设定新的标准水平。
围绕交通和气候变化的关注革命正变得越来越清晰，并且正在当下真实发生。
但我们周围的交通系统陈旧且破损：拥有一辆车、购买昂贵的公交车票、寻找加油站或选择不确定的等待时间。
Salo就像是迷你版的芬兰：海景、数百个湖泊、美丽的国家公园、广阔的空间和宁静的生活。就像你在Instagram动态中看到的照片一样：是的，就是这么酷。此外，手机革命始于Salo：你知道诺基亚。
现在我们正在构建下一场革命。我们挑战你创新一个革命性的永不停歇的交通系统，它将最大化人们生活的自由，同时最小化交通对环境的危害。我们已经拥有感应充电、电动汽车和数据。我们如何构建最先进的“永不停歇的交通系统”，使其在全球范围内可扩展？我们知道Salo是测试的最佳地点，因为我们有很棒的人和灵活的营商环境。挑战在于向我们展示如何实现这一点！

Description:
Develop a solution or solutions that generate information by joining, analyzing and visualizing open data sets. This solution should able to be embedded in websites, update information automatically and generate information that interests especially enterprises.
National, regional and local governments generate uncounted amounts of various open data sets. These open data sets can be transformed into useful regional information by using data analyzing tools which the city of Espoo has already done to some extent.
However, this already analyzed regional information is often scattered or otherwise difficult to find. Also, due to limited financial resources much of this regional data has not been analyzed. As a result, various private actors experience difficulties in acquiring all the relevant and necessary information.
The city of Espoo is looking for cost-effective ways to transform data sets into useful regional information and distribute it to various private actors already located in Espoo area or aiming to relocate/expand into Espoo area.
The challenge is to develop a solution or solutions that generate information by joining, analyzing and visualizing open data sets. This solution should generate information that interests especially enterprises. Also, this solution should be able to be embedded in different type of websites and update information automatically.
description_zh:
开发一种或多种解决方案，通过连接、分析和可视化开放数据集来生成信息。该解决方案应能够嵌入网站、自动更新信息，并生成尤其令企业感兴趣的信息。
国家、地区和地方政府生成了不计其数的各种开放数据集。通过使用数据分析工具，这些开放数据集可以转化为有用的区域信息，埃斯波市已经在某种程度上做到了这一点。
然而，这些已经分析过的区域信息往往分散或难以找到。此外，由于财政资源有限，许多区域数据尚未得到分析。因此，各种私营主体在获取所有相关且必要的信息时遇到困难。
埃斯波市正在寻找具有成本效益的方法，将数据集转化为有用的区域信息，并将其分发给已经位于埃斯波地区或计划迁入/扩展到埃斯波地区的各种私营主体。
挑战在于开发一种或多种解决方案，通过连接、分析和可视化开放数据集来生成信息。该解决方案应生成尤其令企业感兴趣的信息。此外，该解决方案应能够嵌入不同类型的网站并自动更新信息。

Description:
The City of Espoo is looking for the best ways to help enterprises in matching and connecting to grow their business. Current challenges are:
  Startups development ideas don’t find suitable testing environments.
  Corporates don’t find new products, solutions and technologies
  Startups with novel solutions don’t find multinational corporates to gain corporate references.
  We need modern technology to boost the more systematic matching of startups and corporates.
What could be a solution for creating win-win situations for startups and corporates?
Particularly matching corporations with the right startups needs new innovations, e.g. an algorithm evaluating or predicting match qualities that could be used in our existing platform.
description_zh:
埃斯波市正在寻找最佳方式，帮助企业进行匹配和连接，以发展其业务。当前的挑战包括：
  初创企业的发展想法找不到合适的测试环境。
  企业找不到新产品、解决方案和技术。
  拥有新颖解决方案的初创企业找不到跨国企业来获得企业参考。
  我们需要现代技术来促进初创企业和企业之间更系统化的匹配。
对于为初创企业和企业创造双赢局面，什么可能是一个解决方案？
特别是将企业与合适的初创企业匹配需要新的创新，例如一种评估或预测匹配质量的算法，可以用于我们现有的平台。

Description:
Understanding people flows is crucial for retailers to decide on a location as well as for real estate developers when planning services and retail. IoT solutions are making their way rapidly to the retail industry to revitalize physical stores while they have lost grounds to the e-commerce. Imagine if you could access the data of people’s behavior, habits, movements and daily routines within a whole city or a regional area – what possibilities would it bring to location-based services?
In this challenge you can access the wifi data of the whole Otaniemi campus area. Which data points could be combined and how could this knowledge affect the daily lives of students using the campus?
We are looking for new ways to help data-analytics in supporting leasing, retailer sales, on-spot advertisement, events and customer satisfaction on the Aalto University campus. The team with best knowledge and prediction capability on people flows wins the game.
Aalto University is building and developing a smart customer centric Aalto Campus, a campus area resembling a small city with technologies never seen or piloted before. One significant element in developing the area is the service infrastructure, a dynamic entity that provides quality services and creates revenue for the retailers. The new shopping center A Bloc is the central point of services in Otaniemi and aims to be a living lab in developing new technologies e.g. in predicting people flows and directing them in the wanted locations.
description_zh:
理解人流对于零售商决定选址以及房地产开发商规划服务和零售至关重要。物联网解决方案正迅速进入零售行业，为重振因电子商务而失去地盘的实体店注入活力。想象一下，如果您能获取整个城市或区域范围内人们的行为、习惯、移动和日常作息数据——这将为基于位置的服务带来哪些可能性？
在本挑战中，您可以访问整个Otaniemi校区区域的WiFi数据。哪些数据点可以结合，这些知识如何影响使用校区的学生的日常生活？
我们正在寻找新方法，帮助数据分析支持Aalto大学校区的租赁、零售商销售、现场广告、活动和客户满意度。对人流拥有最佳知识和预测能力的团队将赢得比赛。
Aalto大学正在建设和开发以客户为中心的智能Aalto校区，该校区区域类似于一个小城市，采用前所未有的技术或试点。开发该区域的一个重要元素是服务基础设施，这是一个提供优质服务并为零售商创造收入的动态实体。新的购物中心A Bloc是Otaniemi的服务中心，旨在成为开发新技术的生活实验室，例如预测人流并将他们引导至想要的位置。

Description: You just found the best spot on the sofa and you’re in the middle of a video game or just minding your own business, when the desire of sweet and yummy hits you like a hammer. You’re not in the mood to move your ass, though. The question is: how mobile are your munchies?\nWe’re looking for an entertaining solution in the spirit of street science to solve a tricky problem: how to control a pick’ n’ pay candy robot with a mobile device.
description_zh:
你刚找到沙发上最舒服的位置，正沉浸在电子游戏中或只是忙自己的事，突然对甜食和美味零食的渴望猛烈袭来。然而，你懒得动弹。问题是：你的零食有多大的移动性？
我们正在寻找一种符合街头科学精神的娱乐性解决方案，来解决一个棘手的问题：如何用移动设备控制一个即选即付的糖果机器人。

Challenge name: Health, Sustainability and Convenience Through Data
Description:
As the world’s most sustainable trading sector company, we want to support our customers’ everyday life towards a more sustainable and healthier way. We have loads of retail transaction data from the grocery trade and other retail segments. There is a lot of potential in the customer-friendly utilisation of this data: we could create services that support our customers in making better choices daily.
We have an extensive data-pool and a desire to utilise it when developing new services, both data-based and others. Data enables us to offer customers a personalised, helpful and smooth customer experience in stores and online.
Customers expect 24/7 availability of services irrespective of place. Mobile access plays an important role. K Group aims to make use of these  possibilities of mobile and online services as well as digital marketing technologies and data that enable one-to-one marketing.
Consumer knowledge and power have increased, which requires clear customer promises and top-notch delivery from us. Thus, we want to provide comprehensive information about products, such as prices and availability, health benefits, and the origin and responsibility of our products. We take local tastes and needs into consideration when selecting the services and goods for a K-store and we particularly invest in the revamping of neighbourhood retail services.
We are committed to develop our business in a sustainable way by, for example, promoting the use of renewable energy and innovative circular economy solutions and ensuring responsibility throughout the supply chain.
name_zh: 通过数据实现健康、可持续与便利
description_zh:
作为全球最具可持续性的贸易行业公司，我们希望支持客户的日常生活走向更可持续、更健康的方式。我们拥有大量来自杂货贸易和其他零售领域的零售交易数据。在客户友好的数据利用方面存在巨大潜力：我们可以创建服务，支持客户每天做出更好的选择。
我们拥有广泛的数据池，并希望在开发新服务（包括基于数据的服务和其他服务）时利用它。数据使我们能够在店内和线上为客户提供个性化、有帮助且流畅的客户体验。
客户期望无论身处何地都能24/7获得服务。移动访问发挥着重要作用。K Group旨在利用移动和在线服务的这些可能性，以及数字营销技术和实现一对一营销的数据。
消费者的知识和力量已经增强，这要求我们做出清晰的客户承诺并提供一流的交付。因此，我们希望提供关于产品的全面信息，例如价格和可用性、健康益处，以及我们产品的原产地和责任。在为K-store选择服务和商品时，我们会考虑当地口味和需求，并特别投资于社区零售服务的改造。
我们致力于以可持续的方式发展业务，例如，推广可再生能源的使用和创新循环经济解决方案，并确保整个供应链的责任。

Description: Every day, sub-optimal planning leads to tons of food waste and excessive storage needs. This challenge is about using novel approaches like computer vision, or real-time point-of-sales data, to combat real life problems that retailers face. We want you to help us imagine completely new ways of collecting, analyzing and processing data, and create solutions that benefit both retailers and us. Step into our pop-up “Zero Waste Shop” and start collecting your data. You code, the planet benefits.
description_zh: 每天，次优的规划导致大量食物浪费和过度的存储需求。本挑战旨在利用计算机视觉或实时销售点数据等新颖方法，解决零售商面临的现实问题。我们希望您帮助我们构想全新的数据收集、分析和处理方式，并创建既有利于零售商也有利于我们的解决方案。走进我们的快闪“零废弃商店”，开始收集您的数据。您编码，地球受益。

Description:
Imagine a situation where a natural disaster hits your neighborhood, and local communication infrastructure is knocked out. In the middle of the havoc, how can you reach out and tell your family and loved ones that you are still here, alive and kicking? Or indicate that you are hurt, in danger, needing help?
Smartphones and wearable devices collect lots of data, which can be made available to indicate the wearer’s whereabouts and condition. The sensor data streams can be analyzed and interpreted for example by machine learning solutions in cloud (or any other suitable place), to produce and make available indication of danger, aliveness, etc.
This challenge is twofold:
- Provide (at least) a conceptual plan with evidence of technical feasibility on how to create and deploy distributed narrow band IoT connectivity when local infra is down.
- Build an application which demonstrates the capability of applicable wearable device to provide sensor data and acting as a gateway towards IoT cloud. Note that the same solution may be used for smaller scale incidents (like car accidents) when the local communication infrastructure is intact.
description_zh:
设想一个场景：自然灾害袭击了你的社区，本地通信基础设施被摧毁。在混乱之中，你如何联系家人和亲人，告诉他们你依然在这里，活蹦乱跳？或者表明你受伤了、处于危险中、需要帮助？
智能手机和可穿戴设备收集了大量数据，这些数据可以用来指示佩戴者的行踪和状况。传感器数据流可以通过云端（或其他任何合适的地方）的机器学习解决方案进行分析和解读，从而生成并提供危险、存活等指示。
这个挑战分为两部分：
- 提供（至少）一个概念性方案，并附上技术可行性证据，说明如何在本地基础设施瘫痪时创建和部署分布式窄带物联网连接。
- 构建一个应用程序，演示适用的可穿戴设备提供传感器数据并充当通往物联网云端的网关的能力。请注意，同样的解决方案也可用于本地通信基础设施完好的较小规模事件（如车祸）。

Description: Ericsson challenges you to step into the shoes of a Cyber Detective with the aim of spotting the malicious network nodes attacking the mobile network endpoints. To achieve this, you need to create an anomaly detection solution to detect attack messages from signaling traffic. The solution is supposed to include a complete pipeline from the network capture dataset to the result that points out the attacks from the message data and the malicious nodes in the network.
description_zh: Ericsson 挑战你扮演网络侦探，目标是识别攻击移动网络端点的恶意网络节点。为此，你需要创建一个异常检测解决方案，从信令流量中检测攻击消息。该解决方案应包含从网络捕获数据集到结果的完整流水线，结果需从消息数据中指出攻击以及网络中的恶意节点。

Description:
The amount of cyber-attacks is growing all the time. Security analysts spend a lot of their precious time looking for new threats, finding information about the threat actors and to connect the dots manually. Ericsson challenges you to jump into a security analyst’s stinky shoes (pun intended) and create a solution to deal with this almost unbearable task. Can you make a system that will smell the new threats before they reach you, and shed light to the structure and organization of the threat actors? Can you figure out what the internet has to say about this new threat actor you just stumbled upon? Can you combine indicators of compromise for these threats with the human readable information about the related threat actors all available on the internet?
There will be three focus areas in the challenge.
1. Choosing and information retrieval from different sources
2. Implementation of a data processing solution to filter and combine the relevant issues from retrieved sources
3. Presenting the resulting information to the security analyst in a valuable way
description_zh:
网络攻击的数量一直在增长。安全分析师花费大量宝贵时间寻找新威胁、查找有关威胁行为者的信息并手动连接线索。Ericsson 挑战您穿上安全分析师臭气熏天的鞋子（双关语意），创建一个解决方案来应对这项几乎无法忍受的任务。您能否构建一个系统，在 new threats 到达您之前嗅出它们，并揭示威胁行为者的结构和组织？您能否弄清楚互联网对您刚刚偶然发现的这个新威胁行为者有什么说法？您能否将这些威胁的妥协指标与互联网上可用的相关威胁行为者的人类可读信息结合起来？
挑战将有三个重点领域。
1. 从不同来源选择和信息检索
2. 实施数据处理解决方案，以过滤和组合检索来源中的相关问题
3. 以有价值的方式向安全分析师呈现结果信息

Description: Do you know what almost all roads worldwide have in common? A truck has been there. And now your code can be there too! Now, real-time truck data is readily available for developers to build applications.\nIt’s just you and our SDK. Will you choose to brave your destiny and go, where no code has gone before? Then create an Android application leveraging the live vehicle data exposed by our SDK for the Mercedes-Benz Truck App Portal and help the logistics industry maximize its efficiency.
description_zh:
你知道全球几乎所有道路的共同点是什么吗？卡车已经去过那里。现在，你的代码也可以到达那里！如今，开发者可以轻松获取实时卡车数据来构建应用程序。
只有你和我们的 SDK。你会选择勇敢面对命运，前往代码从未涉足的地方吗？那么，请创建一个利用我们 SDK 为 Mercedes-Benz Truck App Portal 提供的实时车辆数据的 Android 应用程序，帮助物流行业最大化其效率。

Description: Cars are steadily becoming more connected, and digital displays and user interfaces are beginning to take over from analog ones. The user experience will become more personalized, and outside intelligence will be integrated into the in-car environment. With the right tools, automotive user interfaces will become context-sensitive, adapting to conditions inside or outside the vehicle. These trends introduce exciting new possibilities for the automotive user experience!\nLook into the future! What services do you think should be integrated into the connected car of tomorrow? How should these services interact with each other? What should they enable, how should they be implemented, and what should they look like? Show innovation and let your creativity shine!
name_zh: 互联汽车用户体验挑战赛
description_zh:
汽车正稳步变得更加互联，数字显示屏和用户界面开始取代模拟界面。用户体验将变得更加个性化，外部智能将被整合到车内环境中。借助合适的工具，汽车用户界面将变得情境感知，能够适应车内或车外的条件。这些趋势为汽车用户体验带来了激动人心的新可能性！
展望未来！您认为哪些服务应该被整合到明天的互联汽车中？这些服务应如何相互交互？它们应该实现什么功能，应如何实现，以及它们应该是什么样子？展现创新，让您的创造力闪耀！

Description: The air cargo industry has many processes that could be optimized by digitalization. For example, the total carbon footprint of deliveries could be reduced by better use of available capacity.\nAt the moment, changes in tight schedules are solved manually. We believe that smart algorithms could help these people in their everyday jobs to make better, more efficient and faster decisions.\nFrom the end users’ point of view, the current process of delivery tracking could be more transparent. It would be fair to notify customers about incoming delays as soon as possible.
description_zh: 航空货运行业有许多流程可以通过数字化进行优化。例如，通过更好地利用可用运力，可以减少交付的总碳足迹。\n目前，紧凑日程中的变更都是手动解决的。我们相信，智能算法可以帮助这些人在日常工作中做出更好、更高效、更快速的决策。\n从最终用户的角度来看，当前的交付跟踪流程可以更加透明。尽快通知客户即将发生的延误是合理的。

Challenge name: The Best Electric Vehicle Charging Experience
Description:
Bob is an EV driver. He is travelling from Stuttgart to Amsterdam on a business trip. He starts his journey on Monday morning from Stuttgart. On the way, he charges at different charging stations @Public and @Highway. At the end of his journey, he charges @Hotel. The next day he charges @Work and starts his way back from Amsterdam to Stuttgart. At the end of his journey, he charges @Home.
Bob wants to experience the following:
He wants to reserve the charging stations on the way
Since he is on a long haul, he wants to get updates about peak hours of charging stations usage, charging tariff, nearby POI in his app in advance so that he can plan his travel in a pleasant manner
He wants to have a seamless charging experience no matter where he charges his car @home, @hotel, @highway, @workplace
He wants to make online payments for charging via his mobile app.
Insights:
The transition to electrification is underway with over 2 million electric vehicles (EVs) on the road today. Charging a battery can take between 2 and 4 hours. With the increasing number of EVs on the road and with limited amount of charging stations it is a challenge how to improve the whole charging experience for our EV customers at the same time being competitive, innovative, creative and fast to market. Living up to the expectations of Mercedes-Benz being “The Best or Nothing”.                                                                                                                  Please note: Currently there are different charging service providers for each infrastructure à Public, Highway, Home, Work etc.
How can Bob have a seamless charging experience despite having different service providers and different IT applications in the background?

Points to consider:
AC and DC charging
Different charging service providers (CSP) with heterogeneous IT infrastructure
Integration of CSPs to Daimler Mobile and Vehicle platform
name_zh: 最佳电动汽车充电体验
description_zh:
Bob是一名电动汽车驾驶员。他正在从斯图加特到阿姆斯特丹出差。他周一早上从斯图加特出发。途中，他在@Public和@Highway的不同充电站充电。旅程结束时，他在@Hotel充电。第二天，他在@Work充电，然后开始从阿姆斯特丹返回斯图加特的旅程。旅程结束时，他在@Home充电。
Bob希望体验以下内容：
他希望预订途中的充电站
由于他是长途旅行，他希望提前在应用程序中获取充电站使用高峰时段、充电费率、附近POI的更新，以便他能以愉快的方式规划旅行
无论在哪里充电（@home、@hotel、@highway、@workplace），他都希望拥有无缝的充电体验
他希望通过移动应用程序进行在线支付充电费用。
insights_zh:
向电气化转型正在进行中，目前道路上有超过200万辆电动汽车（EV）。为电池充电可能需要2到4小时。随着道路上电动汽车数量的增加和充电站数量的有限，如何改善我们电动汽车客户的整体充电体验，同时保持竞争力、创新性、创造力和快速上市，是一个挑战。要符合梅赛德斯-奔驰“The Best or Nothing”的期望。
请注意：目前每个基础设施（公共、高速公路、家庭、工作等）都有不同的充电服务提供商。
尽管背景中有不同的服务提供商和不同的IT应用程序，Bob如何能拥有无缝的充电体验？

需要考虑的要点：
交流和直流充电
具有异构IT基础设施的不同充电服务提供商（CSP）
将CSP集成到戴姆勒移动和车辆平台

Description: Car charging can be much more than just plugging a car and filling the battery. Cars are charged in homes, workplaces, hotels, shopping malls, car parks and airports, to just mention a few, and in all these places the user may have different needs. Create the best possible car charging experience for the electric car driver on one or more segments. Implement/demo this solution utilizing Ensto’s platform offered REST API and additional functionality developed on top of the provided development boards. You can also utilize the already collected IoT data from our backend service for your solution.
name_zh: 教电动汽车充电器新技巧
description_zh: 汽车充电远不止插上电源给电池充电那么简单。汽车会在家庭、工作场所、酒店、购物中心、停车场和机场等场所充电，仅举几例，而在所有这些场所中，用户可能有不同的需求。在一个或多个细分场景中，为电动汽车驾驶员创造最佳的充电体验。利用 Ensto 平台提供的 REST API 以及在提供的开发板上开发的附加功能来实现/演示此解决方案。您还可以利用我们从后端服务中已收集的 IoT 数据来完善您的解决方案。

Description: MobilePay offers solutions to everyday payment situations – with subscriptions and invoices being one of the latest products. Related MobilePay APIs have been in the market since 2017, allowing personal users to pay for their subscriptions and invoices via mobile phone on-the-go.\nTo innovate and expand to new contexts with our products, we are offering a challenge to improve or create a new use case for the APIs directed to the Nordic markets.\nWe want you to take flight without restraints: feel free to rethink even the fundamentals – starting from user journeys to merchant interactions! What would you do with 4,4 million registered users?
description_zh:
MobilePay 为日常支付场景提供解决方案——订阅和发票是其最新产品之一。相关的 MobilePay API 自 2017 年就已进入市场，允许个人用户通过手机随时随地支付订阅费用和发票。
为了创新并将我们的产品拓展到新的场景，我们提出一项挑战：为面向北欧市场的 API 改进或创造新的用例。
我们希望你们不受束缚地展翅高飞：请随意重新思考甚至是最基础的部分——从用户旅程到商户互动！面对 440 万注册用户，你会怎么做？

Description: Data has become the most valuable natural resource. Imagine a situation where all the data in the world would be available for innovative service designers and bright tech-gurus. Imagine a situation where you as a customer could have access to tailor-made, personalised service offerings which have harnessed all your digital data. This is what Sitra, the Finnish Innovation Fund, a think-and-do-tank, wants to try out in its challenge.
description_zh: 数据已成为最有价值的自然资源。想象一下，世界上所有的数据都能为创新的服务设计师和杰出的技术专家所用。想象一下，作为客户，您可以获得量身定制的个性化服务，这些服务已经充分利用了您的所有数字数据。这正是芬兰创新基金Sitra——一个智库兼行动派——在其挑战中想要尝试的。

Description: Create a point-of-sale with frictionless payments for the urban people rushing from one place to another!\nThe cities of the future will be larger, and city life will be even more hectic. The metropolitan areas are filled with services ranging from self-service pizza kiosks to car/bicycle/hoverboard parking. The current solutions, like card and mobile phone payments, require too much attention from the busy citizen. Unless everything will be paid using targeted outdoor advertising, we need to have zero-friction payments in the streets.
description_zh:
为奔波于城市各处的人们打造一个无摩擦支付的销售点！
未来的城市将更大，城市生活将更加繁忙。大都市区充满了从自助披萨亭到汽车/自行车/悬浮滑板停车等各种服务。当前的解决方案，如银行卡和手机支付，需要忙碌的市民投入过多注意力。除非一切都通过定向户外广告支付，否则我们需要在街道上实现零摩擦支付。

Description: Blast street rebuilding projects! To do accomplish this, you’ll receive access to our massive smart city data. The main part of data is about a major, ongoing rebuilding project (that’s) located on Mechelininkatu, in central Helsinki. We encourage you to go wild with your ideas – that’s what we’re looking for.
description_zh: 引爆街道重建项目！为此，您将获得我们海量智慧城市数据的访问权限。数据的主要部分涉及一个位于赫尔辛基市中心Mechelininkatu的重大在建重建项目。我们鼓励您尽情发挥创意——这正是我们所寻找的。

Description: Facebook’s Spark AR Studio  is a platform for creating augmented reality experiences and runs on over one billion devices globally. We invite you to explore your creativity and build interesting augmented reality experiences on our platform. The best ideas will be awarded with prizes, including: Oculus Go, Airblock Transformable Drone and 360 Camera.
description_zh: Facebook 的 Spark AR Studio 是一个用于创建增强现实体验的平台，全球运行在超过十亿台设备上。我们邀请您发挥创造力，在我们的平台上构建有趣的增强现实体验。最佳创意将获得奖品，包括：Oculus Go、Airblock 可变形无人机和 360 相机。

Description: Esports and gaming keep evolving, with players becoming ever more competitive in their games.\nWe want you to help gamers achieve their full potential, by leveraging player data from the free-to-play multiplayer online battle royale game, Darwin Project, developed and published by Scavengers Studios. Your challenge is to build a proof-of-concept for a digital coach for players looking to truly improve.
description_zh:
电子竞技和游戏不断演进，玩家在游戏中的竞争日益激烈。
我们希望您帮助玩家充分发挥潜力，利用由 Scavengers Studios 开发并发布的免费多人在线大逃杀游戏《达尔文计划》中的玩家数据。您的挑战是为寻求真正提升的玩家构建一个数字教练的概念验证。

Challenge partner: Supercell, Next Games, Small Giant Games
Description: Create a game with the support of the three of the best game companies in Finland, where you create a game based on the theme ‘opposites’. This track is about bringing together passionate game developers to design, plan, and create games that are engaging and addictive.
name_zh: 游戏开发挑战赛主挑战
description_zh: 在芬兰三家顶尖游戏公司的支持下，围绕“对立”主题创作一款游戏。本赛道旨在汇聚充满热情的游戏开发者，共同设计、规划并打造引人入胜、令人上瘾的游戏。

Description: Smartphones are an integral part of our lives. They keep us connected to our loved ones, help us to do our jobs and entertain us. They also generate lots of information about people movement behavior, which can be used to improve decision-making, build better services and optimize our society. We challenge you to innovate revolutionary services that combine our Crowd Insights data with other data sources and AI methods.
description_zh: 智能手机是我们生活中不可或缺的一部分。它们让我们与亲人保持联系，帮助我们完成工作，并为我们提供娱乐。它们还产生了大量关于人员移动行为的信息，这些信息可用于改进决策、构建更好的服务并优化我们的社会。我们挑战您创新革命性服务，将我们的Crowd Insights数据与其他数据源和AI方法相结合。

Description: Controllable smart heating can cut down unnecessary energy consumption. Heating management can be utilized through third party data and a backend service data that is open and scalable. It can learn and remember. But most of all, what else could it do?
description_zh: 可控的智能加热可以减少不必要的能源消耗。加热管理可以通过第三方数据和开放且可扩展的后端服务数据来实现。它可以学习和记忆。但最重要的是，它还能做些什么？

Challenge name: Do Captains Dream of Electric Ships?
Description: At ABB we have a vision that ships should be electric, digital and connected. Help us build upon that vision by creating an innovation for the ship of the future.
description_zh: 在ABB，我们有一个愿景：船舶应该实现电气化、数字化和互联化。通过为未来船舶打造创新方案，帮助我们在这愿景之上更进一步。

Description: Bluetooth® Mesh networking creates new opportunities for interacting with your environment, whether you’re making your home or office smarter using intelligent lighting, heating/cooling, and security systems, or wireless sensor networks.\nThe challenge includes creating an application, on IoT edge gateway, which is communicating and utilizing the capabilities of Bluetooth® Mesh network devices. Examples of such applications could be messaging boards, smart badge system or sensor data collection system.
description_zh:
蓝牙® Mesh组网技术为与周围环境交互创造了新机遇，无论是通过智能照明、供暖/制冷和安全系统让家庭或办公室更智能，还是构建无线传感器网络。
本挑战赛要求开发一款运行于物联网边缘网关的应用程序，该程序能够与蓝牙® Mesh网络设备通信并利用其功能。此类应用的示例包括消息板、智能徽章系统或传感器数据采集系统。

Description: 5G networks will enable high-speed and low-latency mobile connectivity at an unprecedented level. We want you to innovate applications that use 5G to showcase and visualize the difference 5G networks will bring compared to 4G. Zero-ping gaming? Instantaneous downloads? Perfect streaming of 4K videos? Or how about combining them all? Go outside-the-box to summon the future of 5G.
description_zh: 5G网络将以前所未有的水平实现高速、低延迟的移动连接。我们希望您创新应用，利用5G来展示和可视化5G网络与4G相比所带来的差异。零延迟游戏？即时下载？完美的4K视频流？或者将它们全部结合起来怎么样？跳出框框思考，召唤5G的未来。

Description: According to WHO, half of the world lacks access to essential health services due to long distances and high expenses. XR can help to improve access to medical training, distract patients from painful experiences and build empathy. It can also provide guidance and even break the laws of physics. Accenture and Helsinki University Hospital are looking for XR solutions that bring together patients, medical professionals and service providers without physical borders.
name_zh: 超越物理现实的医疗保健
description_zh: 根据世界卫生组织的数据，由于距离遥远和费用高昂，全球一半人口无法获得基本医疗服务。XR 可以帮助改善医疗培训的可及性，分散患者对痛苦体验的注意力，并培养同理心。它还可以提供指导，甚至打破物理定律。Accenture 和赫尔辛基大学医院正在寻找能够将患者、医疗专业人员和服务提供商跨越物理边界连接起来的 XR 解决方案。

Description: The world is full of things that move: an athlete’s body or sports equipment, a machine on a production line, a bridge under traffic, any of us in our daily life, or anything else that we can imagine. Often it would be highly valuable to know how and when these things move – or don’t move. What is the tracking solution that you think the world clearly needs but is still lacking? Build your demo and win great Suunto watches.
description_zh: 世界上充满了运动的事物：运动员的身体或运动装备、生产线上的机器、交通中的桥梁、我们日常生活中的任何人，或者我们能想象到的任何其他事物。通常，了解这些事物如何以及何时运动——或者不运动——会非常有价值。你认为世界明显需要但仍缺乏的追踪解决方案是什么？构建你的演示，赢取精美的 Suunto 手表。

Description: There are a ton of general all-purpose weather apps and services out there – mainly concentrating on forecasts. We want you to show us how weather data can be used and visualized in a meaningful and useful way for some specific real life context. The context could be anything, like sports, different hobbies (e.g. sailing, golf, gardening, mountain biking, storm chasing etc. )  or even businesses (agriculture, construction, freight, aviation etc.)\nWe are interested in new ways of combining weather and environmental data with modern technologies and also how these can be applied in daily life.
description_zh:
市面上有大量通用的天气应用和服务——主要集中于天气预报。我们希望你们展示如何将天气数据以有意义且有用的方式用于某些特定的现实生活场景，并进行可视化。场景可以是任何内容，比如体育运动、不同的爱好（例如帆船、高尔夫、园艺、山地自行车、追风等），甚至是商业领域（农业、建筑、货运、航空等）。
我们对将天气和环境数据与现代技术相结合的新方式感兴趣，也关注这些方式如何应用于日常生活。
