Description: Sauna is a traditional place for bathing and relaxation. It can also be a harsh environment for both people and measurement instruments. The sauna experience has not changed much in centuries: for example, the conditions in sauna are still today measured using mechanical temperature gauges. We feel like it is time to modernise the sauna experience!
description_zh: 桑拿是传统的沐浴和放松场所。它也可能是一个对人和测量仪器都严苛的环境。几个世纪以来，桑拿体验并没有太大变化：例如，如今桑拿房内的条件仍然使用机械温度计来测量。我们觉得是时候让桑拿体验现代化了！

Description:
Conversational platforms will simplify the development of digitally assisted applications, making the user experience more accessible to employees and customers. For example, solid enterprise chatbot services and the ability to provide enterprise semantics to other ecosystem chatbots will help drive market adoption of these interconnected solutions. Here is some food for thought for possible use cases or real-world challenges:
- How voice utilization can help to interact with a chatbot or chat-enabled agent.
- How to derive insights from the dialogs to analyze customer satisfaction.
- Creative ways to use real-time video stream in customer service.
- How to use AI to help customer service agent to provide better answers.
- How to help people with different language skills to communicate using chat.
- Can your solution use augmented reality to impress the customer and help in making buying decisions?
description_zh:
对话式平台将简化数字辅助应用的开发，使员工和客户更容易获得用户体验。例如，稳固的企业聊天机器人服务以及向其他生态系统聊天机器人提供企业语义的能力，将有助于推动这些互联解决方案的市场采用。以下是一些可供参考的用例或现实挑战：
- 语音利用如何帮助与聊天机器人或支持聊天的代理进行交互。
- 如何从对话中获取洞察以分析客户满意度。
- 在客户服务中使用实时视频流的创意方式。
- 如何利用AI帮助客户服务代理提供更好的答案。
- 如何帮助具有不同语言技能的人使用聊天进行交流。
- 您的解决方案能否使用增强现实来打动客户并帮助做出购买决策？

Challenge name: DNA Center - One App to Visualize Them All
Description: You have just created a fancy application and implemented it in your organisation’s network. Luckily in today’s network we can get a lot of information of the application performance in the network. Using the REST APIs of DNA Center controller, create a nice visualization of the health of the applications in your network. Why not even add some troubleshooting tools to find the reason for possible weak performance?
name_zh: DNA Center - 一款应用可视化所有
description_zh: 您刚刚创建了一个出色的应用程序，并将其部署在组织的网络中。幸运的是，在当今的网络中，我们可以获取大量关于应用程序在网络中性能的信息。使用 DNA Center 控制器的 REST API，为网络中应用程序的健康状况创建精美的可视化。为什么不甚至添加一些故障排除工具，以找出可能性能不佳的原因呢？

Description: Today’s retail companies look for new ways to drive customer loyalty and increase number of visits to their physical stores. In this challenge, you will develop an indoor, location-aware creature hunting game for smartphones, based on the BLE beacon or Wi-Fi location technologies in the Cisco Meraki solution. The aim of the game is to entertain young visitors and get their parents to visit store sections with offers that might interest them.
description_zh: 如今，零售公司寻求新方法来提升客户忠诚度并增加实体店访问量。在本次挑战中，您将基于 Cisco Meraki 解决方案中的 BLE 信标或 Wi-Fi 定位技术，开发一款面向智能手机的室内位置感知生物捕捉游戏。该游戏旨在娱乐年轻访客，并引导其父母前往可能感兴趣的商店区域。

Description: Imagine how human to human (or human to machine) interaction will be in the future: AI-assisted, media-rich or clutter-free. How do you see it?\nWe challenge you to invent a way of human-to-human or human-to-machine interaction, a messenger of the future. Think AI-powered messaging, talking with bot assistants, sending only stories or audio, any type of communication other than a simple chat, and much more.
description_zh:
想象未来人与人（或人与机器）的交互方式：AI辅助、富媒体或简洁无干扰。你如何看待它？
我们挑战你发明一种人与人之间或人与机器之间的交互方式，一个未来的信使。思考AI驱动的消息传递、与机器人助手对话、仅发送故事或音频、任何简单聊天之外的通信类型，以及更多。

Description: Security in the connected world is important for all of us. Ericsson as a global service and solution provider considers improvements on security awareness as a top priority. Security threats are everywhere, and we all are targets. It is easy to fall for scams, and make bad security decisions (ending up on bad websites, installing malicious applications, leaking sensitive personal information, etc.). Kids are particularly challenging as a target group, requiring exemplary usability and engagement. Therefore, what works with kids, works with all of us. The purpose of this challenge is to strengthen the users’ resilience against these threats through improved awareness.\n\nThere are no strict requirements for the technical level of the solution and therefore this challenge is for you to show off also your skills in design, prototyping and creativity overall. We are looking for the solutions that raise cybersecurity awareness amongst kids.
Resources: Ericsson will provide: Cybersecurity info - which attacks are most common and how to prevent them. In addition to that, Ericsson will bring professional mentors to share their expertise in cybersecurity and a list of resources that can help inspire your work
description_zh:
在互联世界中，安全对我们所有人都至关重要。作为全球服务和解决方案提供商，Ericsson 将提升安全意识视为重中之重。安全威胁无处不在，我们每个人都是目标。人们很容易上当受骗，做出糟糕的安全决策（最终访问不良网站、安装恶意应用程序、泄露敏感个人信息等）。儿童作为目标群体尤其具有挑战性，需要 exemplary 的可用性和参与度。因此，对儿童有效的方案，对我们所有人都有效。本挑战的目的是通过提高意识来增强用户对这些威胁的抵御能力。

对解决方案的技术水平没有严格要求，因此本挑战旨在展示您在设计、原型制作和整体创造力方面的技能。我们正在寻找能够提高儿童网络安全意识的解决方案。
resources_zh: Ericsson 将提供：网络安全信息——哪些攻击最常见以及如何预防它们。此外，Ericsson 还将带来专业导师分享他们在网络安全方面的专业知识，以及一份可以帮助启发您工作的资源列表。

Description:
Current trends show global population is moving to urban areas. With bigger and denser cities, transport of people and goods is getting more complicated. With such volume, if we continue with the same methodologies for city transportation, air pollution and organization will become critical problems.

The introduction of 5G technologies will enable different transportation models by centralizing the transport decision making without suffering much from latency and aggregate information from several sources. You as a team find ways to optimize city wide transportation challenge between different actors.

The goal is to transport as many customers as possible to their destinations. At the end of the hackathon we are going to put all participants on the same simulation and you will compete for the customers. Whoever gets more points wins. We will probably have several rounds.

This challenge is a great place to show your development skills with any modern software technology you prefer!
Insights: We don't care how you optimize the delivery of customers, it can be a simple if then, AI, machine learning, whatever. The challenge is for you to show off your skills in modern software development, prototyping, with a twist of shining creativity.
Resources: Ericsson will provide: A server with a simple API where you can control your fleet of cars and see the world status. In addition to this, we will also provide amazing mentors.
description_zh:
当前趋势显示全球人口正不断向城市地区迁移。随着城市规模扩大和密度增加，人员和货物的运输变得越来越复杂。在如此庞大的运输量下，如果我们继续沿用相同的城市交通方法，空气污染和组织管理将成为严峻问题。

5G 技术的引入将通过集中化交通决策（而不会因延迟受到太大影响）并聚合来自多个来源的信息，从而支持不同的运输模式。作为团队，你们需要找到优化不同参与者之间城市范围交通挑战的方法。

目标是尽可能多地将客户运送至目的地。在黑客松结束时，我们将把所有参与者置于同一模拟环境中，你们将争夺客户。得分更高者获胜。我们可能会进行多轮比赛。

这个挑战是展示你使用任何你喜欢的现代软件技术开发能力的绝佳平台！
insights_zh: 我们不在乎你如何优化客户配送，可以是简单的 if-then 逻辑、AI、机器学习，任何方式都行。挑战在于让你展示在现代软件开发、原型设计方面的技能，并融入闪耀的创造力。
resources_zh: Ericsson 将提供：一台带有简单 API 的服务器，你可以通过它控制你的车队并查看世界状态。此外，我们还将提供出色的导师。

Challenge name: Social Impact with Finland's Open Data
Description:
Finland has a variety of open data sets available, from public transportation, air quality, 3D-models of the cities, health, social services and more. We’re looking for projects that are either completely based on the open data sets (visualizing etc.), or leveraging open data as a part of a larger solution.

Solutions can be built with the technology of your choice, and leverage one or multiple Azure services in your solution, with a focus on data science techniques. Your solution can be built with the tools, languages, frameworks and platforms of your choice. You are free to apply to other challenges, and leverage Open Data in that solution to qualify for the Microsoft challenge.

We’re looking for a solution that leverages data science techniques on Azure, and our data & AI services.
description_zh:
芬兰拥有多种开放数据集，涵盖公共交通、空气质量、城市3D模型、健康、社会服务等领域。我们正在寻找完全基于开放数据集的项目（如可视化等），或将开放数据作为更大解决方案一部分的项目。

解决方案可以使用您选择的技术构建，并在解决方案中利用一个或多个Azure服务，重点关注数据科学技术。您的解决方案可以使用您选择的工具、语言、框架和平台构建。您可以自由申请其他挑战，并在该解决方案中利用开放数据以获得微软挑战的资格。

我们正在寻找利用Azure上的数据科学技术以及我们的数据和AI服务的解决方案。

Description:
Dive into 1,7 billion data rows of pulsing heart of Helsinki city. Identify behavioural patterns, from real-life city scale environment. Find ways to advance the perception of how the city dynamics work. Improve the city experience that will benefit the people as well as the planet.

Explore a large data set of tourist movement from Port of Helsinki. Discover key interest locations and behavioural models. Find ways to analyse the people flow between key locations and areas, and ways to optimize city services for example for transportation.

This challenge is looking for innovative ways to visualize any findings and novel ways to find useful  insights by combining data from different sources.
Resources: Business finland will provide: REST API and API key  for accessing the data set, API Documentation, Technical support on-site, Links to supporting open data APIs from various sources, providing access to points of interest, events, traffic volumes, weather, 3D model of Helsinki and public transportation.
description_zh:
深入探索赫尔辛基城市跳动心脏的17亿行数据。从真实的城市尺度环境中识别行为模式。寻找方法以提升对城市动态运作方式的认知。改善城市体验，造福人民和地球。

探索赫尔辛基港游客流动的大型数据集。发现关键兴趣地点和行为模型。寻找分析关键地点和区域之间人流的方法，以及优化城市服务（例如交通）的方式。

本挑战赛寻求创新的方式来可视化任何发现，以及通过结合不同来源的数据来发现有用见解的新颖方法。
resources_zh: Business Finland 将提供：用于访问数据集的 REST API 和 API 密钥、API 文档、现场技术支持、指向各种来源的支持性开放数据 API 的链接，提供对兴趣点、事件、交通流量、天气、赫尔辛基 3D 模型和公共交通的访问。

Challenge name: Protection Against Targeted and Personalized Email Attacks
Description: Cyber criminals and spammers pretend to be reliable senders, which creates an ongoing challenge for reliable identification of email messages. How it would be possible to identify them so that they could be classified?
Resources: D-Fence will provide: We provide large collection of spam mails that you can analyse.
name_zh: 针对定向和个性化电子邮件攻击的防护
description_zh: 网络犯罪分子和垃圾邮件发送者会伪装成可靠的发件人，这给电子邮件的可靠识别带来了持续挑战。如何才能识别它们，以便对其进行分类？
resources_zh: D-Fence 将提供：我们提供大量可供分析的垃圾邮件集合。

Challenge name: How to make invisible cloud service visible to users?
Description:
We at D-Fence make security service which rejects email spam & viruses from reaching the end users. Our clients are very happy with our service, but actually only few may know that they are using it. Usually the client does not have to do anything once the service is enabled, which in itself is great, but at the same time creates the problem of many of the clients not knowing or forgetting that they are in trusted hands.

How could you help us to make our security services more engaging. Could you help out how we could make the service more visible to the end users? What benefit could it bring both the individual user and the client as a whole?

What if the end user could have some kind of “icon”, that could be used for different kind of functions? Like sending samples of received spam, colour signaling the “threat level”.
New visual and content outlay for the monthly security report.
Resources: D-fence will provide: Current technology and process how we inform our customers with a monthly security report now.  We can provide a sample report so you can see the current status. We gather the information at domain based, and it shows total received emails, total rejected viruses, total rejected spam and percentages for both of the rejections. In the end of the report is a list of rejected viruses.
name_zh: 如何让无形的云服务对用户可见？
description_zh:
我们D-Fence提供安全服务，阻止垃圾邮件和病毒到达最终用户。我们的客户对服务非常满意，但实际上可能只有少数人知道他们正在使用它。通常，客户在启用服务后无需做任何操作，这本身很好，但同时导致许多客户不知道或忘记他们处于可信赖的保护之下。

您能如何帮助我们让安全服务更具吸引力？您能帮助思考如何让服务对最终用户更加可见吗？这能为个人用户和整个客户带来什么好处？

如果最终用户能有某种“图标”，可用于不同功能呢？比如发送收到的垃圾邮件样本，用颜色信号表示“威胁级别”。
为月度安全报告提供新的视觉和内容布局。
resources_zh: D-fence将提供：当前我们如何通过月度安全报告通知客户的技术和流程。我们可以提供一份样本报告，以便您了解当前状态。我们按域名收集信息，显示总收到的电子邮件、总拒绝的病毒、总拒绝的垃圾邮件以及两种拒绝的百分比。报告末尾是拒绝的病毒列表。

Description:
The challenge is to choose one or more of the problems and you can use whatever technologies you want to use. Try to find answers to: How and when we could strengthen young people's good mental health and reduce factors that undermine it? 
Who should provide the help and when?  
How we can provide the help youngsters need, keep them healthy and in the workforce? 
How could we provide help in different phases of youth? 
What kind of extra tools or services could we provide when young adults enter the workforce?
How could different institutions work together to provide seamless services through ecosystems to combat mental health issues? 

Remember that the solution should follow the fair data economy principles:
- data in a digital service or ecosystem are only shared through the individual’s or other data source’s consent.
- data sharing is made transparent by shared rules. Data is not shared with third parties.
- The individual has the possibility to track how their data is used and for what purpose.
Insights:
Mental disorder is the most significant health problem among the young people in Finland. According to THL, around 20-25 % of our young in Finland will have some kind of mental disorder before they become adults. The most typical mental disorders are anxiety, depression, eating disorder and stress. (Kunttu, Pesonen ja Saari 2017) The symptoms of depression is found among 15 % of young people, anxiety among 10%, 10-15% have repetitive suicidal thoughts and 3-5 % of them have tried to commit a suicide.(Tolmunen, 2019)

In Finland, the need for mental health care has increased rapidly during the past few years. Many studies propose that the young people do not have more problems than before, but their attitude is different compared to the earlier generations. They are not ashamed and do not have the attitude ‘’I need to survive on my own’’ and thus are more open for help. One of the problem is that we as a society do not start solving these problems early enough.

According to researcher Mattila-Holappa’s study, the number of early retirement of young people has been raising year by year for ten years now. Keeping young people in the workforce is also crucial for the economy: a young adult’s disability pension can have direct costs of around 0,5m€ along with other indirect costs.
name_zh: 重新构想心理健康护理
description_zh:
挑战在于选择一个或多个问题，并且你可以使用任何你想要的技术。尝试找到以下问题的答案：我们如何以及何时可以加强年轻人的良好心理健康并减少损害它的因素？
谁应该提供帮助以及何时提供？
我们如何提供年轻人所需的帮助，保持他们健康并留在劳动力队伍中？
我们如何在不同青年阶段提供帮助？
当年轻人进入劳动力市场时，我们可以提供什么样的额外工具或服务？
不同机构如何合作，通过生态系统提供无缝服务以应对心理健康问题？

请记住，解决方案应遵循公平数据经济原则：
- 数字服务或生态系统中的数据仅通过个人或其他数据源的同意进行共享。
- 通过共享规则使数据共享透明化。数据不与第三方共享。
- 个人有可能跟踪其数据如何被使用以及用于什么目的。
insights_zh:
精神障碍是芬兰年轻人中最显著的健康问题。根据THL的数据，芬兰大约20-25%的年轻人在成年之前会患有某种精神障碍。最常见的精神障碍是焦虑、抑郁、饮食失调和压力。（Kunttu, Pesonen ja Saari 2017）在15%的年轻人中发现抑郁症状，10%有焦虑，10-15%有重复的自杀念头，其中3-5%曾尝试自杀。（Tolmunen, 2019）

在芬兰，过去几年对心理健康护理的需求迅速增加。许多研究提出，年轻人并没有比以前更多的问题，但他们的态度与 earlier generations 不同。他们不感到羞耻，也没有“我需要自己生存”的态度，因此更愿意接受帮助。问题之一是我们作为一个社会没有足够早地开始解决这些问题。

根据研究员Mattila-Holappa的研究，年轻人的提前退休人数十年来逐年上升。让年轻人留在劳动力队伍中对经济也至关重要：一个年轻人的残疾养老金可能产生约50万欧元的直接成本以及其他间接成本。

Description:
With increased life expectancy and an aging population, the global burden to provide cancer treatment increases in the future. The planning of radiation therapy (RT) consists of optimizing the arrangement of ionizing radiation sources in order to obtain enough therapeutic radiation to the defined target region while avoiding too much radiation to critical organs and normal tissue. Once a radiation therapy treatment plan has been created, it needs to be approved by the physician. The plan review takes a lot of time from one of the critical resources (oncologist) in the clinic and we are looking for novel solutions utilizing modern technology to reduce the spend in that.

Once RT plan has been created by the planner (dosimetrist or physicist), it is stored in a database, waiting for the physicist to approve it, which requires (among other things)
· to go to the workstation to view the plan, potentially together with the planner.
· to check congruence to the treatment protocol, i.e. reviewing a plethora of constraints related to the dose distributions, quality of radiation source positioning, volume definitions, etc.
· if changes to the plan are needed, to communicate with the planner – often verbally or with side-notes.

We are interested in any solutions in plan review that would reduce the workload of the physician or makes the workflow easier. The modern technology can contain, for example, utilization of machine learning, cloud-based solutions, or mobile devices.
Resources: Varian will provide: We provide access to a treatment planning system, containing example plans, and an API for accessing the database. We also provide technology and clinical experts to assist the use of the system and to explain the details of the plan review process.
name_zh: 有效的放射治疗计划审查
description_zh:
随着预期寿命的增加和人口老龄化，未来全球提供癌症治疗的负担将日益加重。放射治疗（RT）的计划包括优化电离辐射源的布置，以便向定义的目标区域提供足够的治疗辐射，同时避免对关键器官和正常组织造成过多辐射。一旦放射治疗计划创建完成，就需要由医生批准。计划审查占用了诊所关键资源（肿瘤科医生）的大量时间，我们正在寻找利用现代技术减少这方面时间投入的新颖解决方案。

一旦放射治疗计划由计划员（剂量师或物理师）创建，它就会被存储在数据库中，等待物理师批准，这需要（除其他事项外）：
· 前往工作站查看计划，可能与计划员一起。
· 检查与治疗方案的一致性，即审查与剂量分布、辐射源定位质量、体积定义等相关的众多约束条件。
· 如果计划需要更改，与计划员沟通——通常通过口头或旁注。

我们对计划审查中任何能减少医生工作量或使工作流程更轻松的解决方案感兴趣。现代技术可以包括，例如，利用机器学习、基于云的解决方案或移动设备。
resources_zh: Varian 将提供：我们提供对治疗计划系统的访问权限，其中包含示例计划，以及用于访问数据库的 API。我们还提供技术和临床专家，以协助使用系统并解释计划审查过程的细节。

Description: We all remember those woodwork classes when we were sweating like never before while smoothening the awesome spoon-to-be with too small piece of sandpaper. Now, imagine a machine that would have 1 000 000 times the surface of a spoon to smoothen at accuracy in micrometers. Doesn’t sound tempting? Paper, board and pulp drying machines need this smoothening grinding service hundreds of hours per year for their rolls. A non-smooth roll will cause losses at speed of 50€ per minute.\n\nThis challenge is excellent for hackers interested in recent developments in the fields of sensor ware, visualisation tools and machine learning, not forgetting to mention that these are real and really big machines in question. Your task is to find ways to make grinding these rolls more effective and in a way, more tempting. So, how do you visualise something so minuscule that can’t be seen with bare eyes?
Resources:
Valmet will provide: Participants are offered a chance to develop on ValmetXR platform. ValmetXR platform provides efficient tools to build customized user-interfaces for documentation and training, by replacing typical manuals with immersive learning environment. ValmetXR incorporates virtual reality, mixed reality and interactive augmented reality experiences via smartphones, tablets and VR/MR headsets in a virtual platform. Platform is based on Unity Engine. All 3D models, 360/2D videos, documents and links can be configured and embedded into the platform. With Node-RED one can wire simulations into ValmetXR.

In addition, Aalto and Valmet provide mentoring for roll grinding, roll behavior and services business. Example datasets demonstrating roll geometry and running paper machines are also provided.

Valmet will provide:
3D Models and XR platform 
Datasets of the paper web from real paper machines
Datasets from paper machine roll roundness measurements
description_zh:
我们都记得那些木工课，当时我们汗流浃背，用太小的砂纸打磨着即将成型的勺子。现在，想象一台机器，它有相当于勺子表面100万倍的面积需要以微米级精度打磨。听起来不诱人吗？纸张、纸板和纸浆干燥机每年需要为其辊子进行数百小时的这种平滑打磨服务。一个不光滑的辊子将以每分钟50欧元的损失速度造成损失。

这个挑战非常适合对传感器硬件、可视化工具和机器学习领域最新发展感兴趣的黑客，更不用说这些是真实且非常庞大的机器。你的任务是找到方法使打磨这些辊子更有效，并在某种程度上更诱人。那么，你如何可视化那些肉眼看不见的微小事物呢？
resources_zh:
Valmet将提供：参与者有机会在ValmetXR平台上进行开发。ValmetXR平台通过用沉浸式学习环境替代典型手册，为文档和培训构建定制用户界面提供了高效工具。ValmetXR通过智能手机、平板电脑和VR/MR头显在虚拟平台中整合了虚拟现实、混合现实和交互式增强现实体验。平台基于Unity引擎。所有3D模型、360/2D视频、文档和链接都可以配置并嵌入平台。使用Node-RED可以将模拟接入ValmetXR。

此外，Aalto和Valmet为辊子打磨、辊子行为和服务业务提供指导。还提供了演示辊子几何形状和运行中的造纸机的示例数据集。

Valmet将提供：
3D模型和XR平台
来自真实造纸机的纸幅数据集
来自造纸机辊子圆度测量的数据集

Challenge name: Using Data to Help People Reduce Food Waste and Live Healthier Lives
Description: This year at Junction, we are proud to announce that CGI is teaming up with K Group, the world’s most sustainable trading sector company. Together we want to find innovative ways to support consumers in making their everyday lives more sustainable and healthier.\n\nImagine the possibilities of using transaction data from grocery retail and other retail segments to create new services to support people in making healthier and more sustainable choices in their everyday lives. Can we find new ways to approach the global issue of reducing food waste and living a healthier lifestyle?
Insights: People are striving to make more sustainable choices in their everyday lives and consumption. Healthy choices, as well as being able to reduce the amount of food waste, are becoming more and more important values in modern society.\n\nAs we know, climate change and increasing emissions raise concerns for many. However, lack of knowledge and tools restrict people from taking measures. It’s time for action and success requires cooperation.
Resources: Kesko will provide: Several APIs for the challenge participants such as search, ingredients, pricing and availability. Other files and documentation such as fully anonymous purchase basket data will also be provided.
name_zh: 利用数据帮助人们减少食物浪费，过上更健康的生活
description_zh:
今年在 Junction，我们自豪地宣布 CGI 与 K Group——全球最具可持续性的贸易行业公司——携手合作。我们共同希望找到创新方法，支持消费者让日常生活更可持续、更健康。

想象一下，利用杂货零售和其他零售领域的交易数据来创建新服务，支持人们在日常生活中做出更健康、更可持续的选择。我们能否找到新方法来应对减少食物浪费和过上更健康生活方式这一全球性问题？
insights_zh:
人们正努力在日常生活中和消费中做出更可持续的选择。健康的选择以及能够减少食物浪费，正成为现代社会中越来越重要的价值观。

众所周知，气候变化和排放增加引发了许多人的担忧。然而，缺乏知识和工具限制了人们采取措施。是时候行动了，成功需要合作。
resources_zh: Kesko 将提供：为挑战参与者提供多个 API，例如搜索、食材、定价和可用性。还将提供其他文件和文档，例如完全匿名的购买篮数据。

Challenge name: Finding ways to keep Finland's national parks enjoyable for both foreign travelers and locals
Description:
Nature travel and outdoors related activities are a trend in the travel industry. Visitor numbers to Finland’s 40 National Parks are growing and certain paths are getting very busy during peak times. Metsähallitus and Visit Finland joined forces and hope to find ways to make sure that travelers and locals can enjoy the unique and fragile national parks now and in the future. Smoothing out the people flow in crowded national parks might be one option, as well as increasing overall sustainability in the national parks.

How to make sure National Park visitors can enjoy the nature and their visit?
How to direct visitors also to the less used tracks and inform them about potential peaks and also low times? How to utilize social media to estimate visitor amounts?
Resources: Visit Finland will provide: Hourly visitor data in CSV format, including e.g. the number of visitors in different National Parks route entrances.
name_zh: 寻找方法让芬兰国家公园持续为外国游客和本地人带来愉悦体验
description_zh:
自然旅行和户外相关活动是旅游业的一大趋势。芬兰40个国家公园的游客数量正在增长，某些路径在高峰时段变得非常繁忙。Metsähallitus和Visit Finland联手，希望找到方法确保旅行者和本地人现在和未来都能享受独特而脆弱的国公园。疏导拥挤国家公园的人流可能是一个选择，同时提高国家公园的整体可持续性。

如何确保国家公园游客能享受自然和他们的访问？
如何引导游客也前往较少使用的路径，并告知他们潜在的峰值和低谷时间？如何利用社交媒体来估计游客数量？
resources_zh: Visit Finland将提供：CSV格式的每小时游客数据，包括不同国家公园路线入口的游客数量等。

Challenge name: Smart Signage - For Student by Students
Description: The Aalto University Student Union (AYY) owns about 2600 apartments, which house around 3500 tenants. AYY has been planning to install information screens (smart signage) to the stairwells and hallways of its apartment buildings. This challenge is about finding solutions and ideas on what these “smart signage” screens could be like in terms of their hardware, but most importantly in terms of their software. What information could they show and what kind of functionality could they include?\n\nAYY would like to see different kinds of ideas and concepts about what kinds of relevant data and functionality could be incorporated into these screens. These can include, for example, data about the building’s heat, water, and electricity consumption, network usage data, AYY’s news and advertising, tenant listings that update automatically, and all kinds of fun functionality that could also work between the screens in different hallways and buildings. At their best, the solutions to this challenge could also improve the experience of communality between the students living in AYY’s housing.
Resources: AYY will provide: AYY’s IT-team will be on promises during the weekend to help you out with the challenge. We will bring an anonymized package of network usage data and HVAC-data from one of our buildings for you to use.
name_zh: 智能标牌——学生为学生设计
description_zh:
阿尔托大学学生会（AYY）拥有约2600套公寓，居住着约3500名租户。AYY一直计划在其公寓楼的楼梯间和走廊安装信息屏幕（智能标牌）。本次挑战旨在寻找这些“智能标牌”屏幕在硬件方面，但最重要的是在软件方面可以如何实现的解决方案和创意。它们可以显示哪些信息，可以包含哪些功能？

AYY希望看到关于哪些相关数据和功能可以整合到这些屏幕中的不同创意和概念。例如，这些数据可以包括建筑物的供暖、用水和用电消耗数据、网络使用数据、AYY的新闻和广告、自动更新的租户列表，以及各种有趣的功能，这些功能还可以在不同走廊和建筑物的屏幕之间运行。在最佳情况下，本次挑战的解决方案还可以改善居住在AYY住房中的学生之间的社区体验。
resources_zh: AYY将提供：AYY的IT团队将在周末期间在线帮助您完成挑战。我们将带来一个来自我们其中一栋建筑的匿名网络使用数据和HVAC数据包供您使用。

Description: When organising events in large spaces there are myriads of interesting problems to solve. These include understanding social clustering such as managing access to the event, production, people flow, venue setup, communications etc. In Junction, CityScienceLab and the Aalto University campus challenge you to create the perfect event experience for participants in large scale venues.\n\nUnderstanding people flows is crucial for location decisions of event organisers. Imagine if you could access the data of people’s behavior, habits, movements and daily routines within an event location – what possibilities would it bring to location-based services using wifi router data? Imagine which data points could be combined and how could knowledge of social patterns affect the daily lives of people on campus or at events? The one idea/demo with the best knowledge and/or prediction capability on people flows on campus wins the game.
Resources: Aalto University will provide: Two Wifi data sets with live access to real-time wifi tracking, sample one week data of building use
description_zh: 在大型空间组织活动时，有无数有趣的问题需要解决。这些问题包括理解社交聚类，例如管理活动入场、制作、人流、场地布置、沟通等。在 Junction 黑客松中，CityScienceLab 和阿尔托大学校园挑战你为大型场馆的参与者创造完美的活动体验。\n\n理解人流对于活动组织者的选址决策至关重要。想象一下，如果你能获取活动场地内人们的行为、习惯、移动和日常作息数据——这将为使用 wifi 路由器数据的基于位置的服务带来哪些可能性？想象一下哪些数据点可以组合，以及对社会模式的了解如何影响校园或活动中人们的日常生活？在校园人流方面拥有最佳知识和/或预测能力的一个想法/演示将赢得比赛。
resources_zh: 阿尔托大学将提供：两个 Wifi 数据集，可实时访问实时 wifi 跟踪，以及建筑使用的一周样本数据

Challenge name: Making Spaces Brighter with Radar Technology
Description:
The ability to identify the human presence in a room has been around for a long time and is used to automatically and reliably control lights. But technological evolution demands innovation, and our goal is to create smarter and intelligent indoor spaces. By applying Machine Learning and AI algorithms on the data from Radar sensors, you can develop futuristic applications capable of delivering state-of-the-art lighting. This is the next step in creating truly smart indoor systems.

Imagine the possibilities when the entire building becomes alive and reacts to the behavior of its occupants. By utilizing advanced sensors such as Radars, can we calculate how many people are in the room and identify their location? Is it possible to identify if people are stationary or moving? If yes, what is their direction of movement?

Similarly, can we detect changes in the behavior of a person working at a desk, and deliver personalized lighting to boost their mood and productivity?

Moreover, it is not only limited to human presence. For example, is it possible to locate empty parking spaces in a garage? Can we identify the direction of the moving vehicle? Such insights have a multitude of applications, ranging from people flow in shopping malls, to building utilization measurements and advanced indoor occupancy sensing for lighting control.
Resources:
Helvar & VTT will provide: Demo Tools, Equipment and Datasets: We will provide a webpage containing luminaires locations on top of the layout of the environment. Participants can then simulate the behavior of the lights by sending commands through an API. Demo luminaires will also be provided, as well as Radar sensors. 

GARAGE: The participants are given a dataset from an indoor garage, collected using an RGB camera and a 60 GHz 2D Radar. The datasets are time-synchronized. People and vehicles are detected from the RGB frames which are represented by bounding boxes, provided in an image coordinate system. Radar data consist of 2D amplitude maps showing the targets in the floor plan coordinate system. 

MEETING ROOM: The participants are given a dataset from a meeting room consisting of 60 GHz 2D radar imaging data and corresponding RGB camera frames. The persons and their skeletons are detected from the RGB frames, and their bounding boxes and joint coordinates are provided in an image coordinate system. Radar data consist of 2D amplitude maps showing the targets in the floor plan coordinate system. The participants are given live access to the Radars for creating online demos. 

WORKPLACE: The participants are provided a dataset of a person that is working with their computer. The dataset includes raw 24 GHz radar data and corresponding RGB camera frames. The vital signs are extracted from the radar data, and person’s joint positions are detected and provided from the RGB frames. Raw radar data consist of amplitude and phase maps that can be used for detecting large and small scale movements. The participants are given live access to the sensors data, which can be used for creating online demos as well.
description_zh:
识别房间内人员存在的能力已存在很长时间，并用于自动可靠地控制灯光。但技术演进要求创新，我们的目标是创建更智能的室内空间。通过将机器学习和人工智能算法应用于雷达传感器数据，您可以开发出能够提供最先进照明的未来应用。这是创建真正智能室内系统的下一步。

想象一下整个建筑变得活跃并对居住者的行为做出反应的可能性。通过利用雷达等先进传感器，我们能否计算房间内有多少人并识别他们的位置？是否有可能识别人员是静止还是移动？如果是，他们的移动方向是什么？

同样，我们能否检测在办公桌前工作的人的行为变化，并提供个性化照明以提升他们的情绪和生产力？

此外，这不仅仅局限于人员存在。例如，是否有可能在车库中定位空停车位？我们能否识别移动车辆的方向？此类洞察具有多种应用，从购物中心的人流到建筑利用率测量以及用于照明控制的高级室内占用传感。
resources_zh:
Helvar & VTT 将提供：演示工具、设备和数据集：我们将提供一个网页，包含环境布局上的灯具位置。参与者可以通过 API 发送命令来模拟灯光的行为。还将提供演示灯具以及雷达传感器。

车库：参与者将获得一个来自室内车库的数据集，使用 RGB 相机和 60 GHz 2D 雷达收集。数据集时间同步。从 RGB 帧中检测到的人和车辆由边界框表示，提供在图像坐标系中。雷达数据包括在平面图坐标系中显示目标的 2D 幅度图。

会议室：参与者将获得一个来自会议室的数据集，包含 60 GHz 2D 雷达成像数据和相应的 RGB 相机帧。从 RGB 帧中检测到人员及其骨架，并提供其边界框和关节坐标在图像坐标系中。雷达数据包括在平面图坐标系中显示目标的 2D 幅度图。参与者可以获得雷达的实时访问权限，用于创建在线演示。

工作场所：参与者将获得一个人使用电脑工作的数据集。数据集包括原始 24 GHz 雷达数据和相应的 RGB 相机帧。从雷达数据中提取生命体征，并从 RGB 帧中检测和提供人员的关节位置。原始雷达数据包括幅度图和相位图，可用于检测大规模和小规模运动。参与者可以获得传感器数据的实时访问权限，也可用于创建在线演示。

Description: The world’s largest online marketplace, established in Asia, meets Europe's largest social network: How social commerce on VK can be set up to create an excellent shopping experience for users.\n\nVK provides a platform for social experiences including e.g. communication, content, thematic communities and useful services. AliExpress provides a wide range of millions of products for customers and businesses, but in addition to that, they provide cloud computing and payment services. Imagine all the solutions that combine the advantages of a social platform and the world’s largest online marketplace together. What is the social platform shopping experience that you have been only dreaming about?
Resources: VK will provide: VK API (including social graph functions) and AliExpress Products API. Our mentors will assist by answering questions about API usage. We also suggest that participants use the VK Mini Apps platform, which is based on the VK UI components library, and allows cross-client services to be created easily.
name_zh: 探索 VK 社交电商
description_zh:
全球最大的在线市场，成立于亚洲，与欧洲最大的社交网络相遇：如何搭建 VK 上的社交电商，为用户创造卓越的购物体验。

VK 提供社交体验平台，包括沟通、内容、主题社区和实用服务等。AliExpress 为消费者和企业提供海量商品，除此之外，还提供云计算和支付服务。想象一下，将所有结合社交平台和全球最大在线市场优势的解决方案汇聚一堂。你一直梦想的社交平台购物体验是什么样的？
resources_zh: VK 将提供：VK API（包括社交图谱功能）和 AliExpress 商品 API。我们的导师将协助解答有关 API 使用的问题。我们还建议参与者使用 VK Mini Apps 平台，该平台基于 VK UI 组件库，可轻松创建跨客户端服务。

Description:
Digital retail suffers from a vast number of mispurchases; people buy products they don’t enjoy due to lack of possibilities to test, feel and evaluate products – and people purchase things in impulse, things they didn’t need in the first place.

All this creates a business model that is heavy on companies and a massive environmental problem, where products are shipped back and forth around the globe, and thrown out or destroyed without ever being used. How can we get rid of mispurchases?

We are living in a time when with the help of technology, data, AI and automation we can start solving these issues. How can technology help people to buy more consciously and companies to sell more sustainably? Possible questions to think about: How to try and evaluate products without shipping & return process? How to create (a digital) shopping experience that offers a better visual, feel and size reference of the products? How to optimise and personalise digital shopping to avoid unneeded purchases
Resources: Columbia road will provide: Teams will be provided with a data set to work with as well as tech and designer mentors who will help with the concepting and implementation of solutions.
description_zh:
数字零售业饱受大量误购之苦；由于缺乏测试、感受和评估产品的可能性，人们会购买自己并不喜欢的产品——而且人们会冲动购买，买下那些他们原本并不需要的东西。

所有这些造就了一种对企业负担沉重的商业模式，并带来了巨大的环境问题：产品在全球范围内来回运输，从未被使用就被丢弃或销毁。我们如何才能消除误购？

我们正处在一个可以借助技术、数据、AI 和自动化开始解决这些问题的时代。技术如何帮助人们更理性地消费，并帮助企业更可持续地销售？可供思考的可能问题包括：如何在不经过运输和退货流程的情况下试用和评估产品？如何打造（数字化）购物体验，提供更好的产品视觉、触感和尺寸参照？如何优化和个性化数字购物，以避免不必要的购买？
resources_zh: Columbia Road 将提供：团队将获得一个可供使用的数据集，以及技术和设计导师，他们将协助构思和实现解决方案。

Description:
Cities of the future will improve the quality of life of citizens by integrating technologies and infrastructure via innovative open platforms.

Edge computing plays an increasing role in the telecom industry all over the world. One of the focus areas of edge development is "smart cities". SUSE is participating in the Akraino / uMEC project that aims to define and deliver a compute platform for network edge devices. The challengers are asked to demonstrate use cases and create a prototype of an open data platform which can collect, analyze and share weather, traffic, emergency information with citizens.

Participants of the challenge will get access to a dedicated WiFi network and a k3s cluster that runs on our uMEC nodes (Raspberry Pi 3B+ and 4B+ boards). This base platform will also include a set of MEC APIs that should be used for solving the challenge. The participants will develop applications on top of these APIs and deploy them into our cluster. More demanding applications can be implemented and deployed using SUSE CAP. In the later case we are interested to see smart integrations between powerful cloud native app deployments and our uMEC network.
Resources: Suse will provide: We will provide a cluster of edge computing nodes including hardware and software. This cluster will serve as the deployment platform for the containerized applications built by the challenge participants. We will provide open implementation of a subset of certain ETSI MEC APIs. \n\nMore demanding solutions can utilize SUSE CAP which enables easy cloud native application development. These solutions must interact with the devices and APIs on uMEC edge network.
description_zh:
未来的城市将通过创新的开放平台整合技术和基础设施，从而提高市民的生活质量。

边缘计算在全球电信行业中扮演着越来越重要的角色。边缘发展的重点领域之一是“智慧城市”。SUSE 正在参与 Akraino / uMEC 项目，该项目旨在为网络边缘设备定义并交付一个计算平台。挑战者需要展示用例，并创建一个开放数据平台的原型，该平台能够收集、分析并与市民共享天气、交通和紧急信息。

挑战的参与者将获得一个专用 WiFi 网络以及一个运行在我们 uMEC 节点（Raspberry Pi 3B+ 和 4B+ 板）上的 k3s 集群的访问权限。这个基础平台还将包括一组 MEC API，这些 API 应被用于解决挑战。参与者将在这些 API 之上开发应用程序，并将其部署到我们的集群中。更复杂的应用程序可以使用 SUSE CAP 进行实现和部署。在后一种情况下，我们希望看到强大的云原生应用部署与我们的 uMEC 网络之间的智能集成。
resources_zh:
SUSE 将提供：我们将提供一个边缘计算节点集群，包括硬件和软件。该集群将作为挑战参与者构建的容器化应用程序的部署平台。我们将提供某些 ETSI MEC API 子集的开放实现。

更复杂的解决方案可以利用 SUSE CAP，它能够轻松实现云原生应用程序开发。这些解决方案必须与 uMEC 边缘网络上的设备和 API 进行交互。

Description:
Each year, there are more than 4 000 smaller and bigger repair projects of the buildings owned by the City of Helsinki. The project is usually defined by real estate “owner” of City of Helsinki, planned by our engineer or supervisor and performed by a professional, such as an electrician, a painter, a plumber or a carpenter. We want to manage these projects in a better way, and step up the processes. The management process: 1. Real estate administrator of City of Helsinki orders the work , 2. initial planning of our own personnel, 3. preparing the entering to the site, 4. performing the actual work often in the middle of everyday life in the space and 5. documenting what has been done (pictures, bill of materials, planning documents, description of the result etc.).

Also informing the end users (such as teachers and a headmaster of a school, a parent of daycare child or an elderly people from their home) during the project is another key area of challenge.

It all comes down to two things: providing more information in advance, in order to minimize the number of planning visits to the site, and afterwards documenting the work, so that result can be controlled, even without another visit to the site.
Resources: Stara will provide: We have mentors with practical hands-on experience and know-how of the data. We will provide detailed data from the processes. The data consists of actual examples, in a simple case pictures and some measurements, maybe a CAD drawing, and in more complex cases (read bigger ones) actual plans and drawings.
description_zh:
每年，赫尔辛基市拥有的建筑有超过4000个大小不一的维修项目。项目通常由赫尔辛基市的房地产“业主”定义，由我们的工程师或主管规划，并由专业人员（如电工、油漆工、水管工或木匠）执行。我们希望更好地管理这些项目，并提升流程效率。管理流程包括：1. 赫尔辛基市房地产管理员订购工作；2. 我们内部人员进行初步规划；3. 准备进入现场；4. 在实际工作中，经常在空间的日常生活中进行；5. 记录已完成的工作（照片、材料清单、规划文件、结果描述等）。

此外，在项目期间告知最终用户（如学校的教师和校长、日托儿童家长或居家老人）是挑战的另一个关键领域。

这一切都归结为两件事：提前提供更多信息，以尽量减少现场规划访问的次数；事后记录工作，以便无需再次访问现场即可控制结果。
resources_zh: Stara将提供：我们拥有具备实践经验和数据知识的导师。我们将提供流程中的详细数据。数据包括实际案例，简单案例中有图片和一些测量数据，可能还有CAD图纸；更复杂的案例（即更大的项目）中则有实际计划和图纸。

Description:
As airlines are aiming to improve the customer experience through digital solutions, one crucial aspect is often forgotten: what happens to your luggage?

Being able to follow each step of your mail deliveries has long been a standard convenience, yet when it comes to luggage you’re left with just hoping it makes it to the end destination on time - and if it doesn’t, figuring out where it actually is can be quite tricky.

Millions of pieces of luggage get lost every year, and packing according to airline restrictions can be a pain. At the same time, airlines are tightening the restrictions on how much luggage you can bring in the cabin with you, encouraging flyers to check in their bags instead.

How could your team help improve the customer experience for flyers traveling with luggage?

We are looking for new ways to improve the existing baggage operations. Whether it's helping the passenger to pack lighter or track and reduce missing luggage, the solution should make traveling an easier, smoother and more comfortable experience.
Insights:
No idea where to start? Here are some ideas of what your solution could do:
Provide customers with more insight
Help airlines track the lost baggage (or even better; help prevent it from being lost in the first place!)
Help passengers to pack lighter and according to travel restrictions (packing restricted items is the main reason for having your luggage ransacked)
Help the baggage information share (tag > passenger > airline)
These are just some examples. Be creative, the sky's the limit!
Resources: QOCO will provide: Luggage API, from which you can get the needed luggage handling data.
description_zh:
随着航空公司致力于通过数字化解决方案提升客户体验，一个关键方面却常常被遗忘：你的行李会经历什么？

能够追踪邮件投递的每一步早已成为标准便利，然而对于行李，你只能寄希望于它准时到达最终目的地——如果未能准时到达，要弄清楚它究竟在哪里可能相当棘手。

每年有数百万件行李丢失，而按照航空公司规定打包行李也可能令人头疼。与此同时，航空公司正在收紧随身携带行李的限制，鼓励旅客托运行李。

你的团队可以如何帮助改善携带行李出行的旅客的客户体验？

我们正在寻找改进现有行李操作的新方法。无论是帮助乘客轻装打包，还是追踪并减少行李丢失，解决方案都应让旅行变得更轻松、更顺畅、更舒适。
insights_zh:
不知从何入手？以下是一些关于你的解决方案可以做什么的想法：
为客户提供更多洞察
帮助航空公司追踪丢失的行李（甚至更好：帮助从一开始就防止行李丢失！）
帮助乘客根据旅行限制轻装打包（打包受限物品是行李被翻查的主要原因）
帮助行李信息共享（标签 > 乘客 > 航空公司）
这些只是几个例子。发挥创意，天空才是极限！
resources_zh: QOCO 将提供：行李 API，你可以从中获取所需的行李处理数据。

Description:
Thanks to the unprecedented pivot from daily life to online life during COVID-19 as well as the ever increasing importance of sustainability, exciting new possibilities for fashion have opened-up, allowing Marimekko to be more sustainable and reach a new audience.

But this change isn’t all that strange! During the last few years more and more 2nd hand C2C marketplaces have been popping up and they have gained the attention and praise of the consumers. But! So far only a few fashion brands have done something in reaction to this opportunity and are yet to reach the full potential in creating a community. This is what Marimekko wants to achieve.

Marimekko wants to be in the forefront of this new movement and show the other industry players the power of having a vibrant community. 

The 2nd hand market is expected to outgrow fast fashion by 2028 but we still have a long road ahead of us in bringing this from niche to mainstream. Thus it is important for fashion brands to be active facilitators in this process to support the development of a circular value chain and ensure their community will still be engaged and active.

How can Marimekko facilitate and enable community members to interact and exchange pre-loved Marimekko items in a way that the process is smooth and the experience is superb?  We want this platform to serve as an active Marimekko community booster so it’s also important to us that the people always come back for new content!
Insights: What elements and other features should the platform include in order to take the consumer experience to the moon and back while giving them the opportunity to shop the prints and clothes they all love? What sets Marimekko’s future platform apart from the existing multi-brand marketplaces and gives it the oumph? \n\nThis challenge offers you the unique opportunity to be completely immersed in the world of fashion and to be free of all restraints and to create completely new things with the support of Marimekko.
Resources: During the event, Marimekko will have mentors to assist you in case you have any questions regarding the challenge.
description_zh:
由于COVID-19期间前所未有的从日常生活转向在线生活，以及可持续性日益增长的重要性，时尚界开启了令人兴奋的新可能性，使Marimekko能够更加可持续并触达新的受众。

但这种变化并不奇怪！在过去几年中，越来越多的二手C2C市场涌现出来，并获得了消费者的关注和赞誉。但是！到目前为止，只有少数时尚品牌对这一机会做出了反应，并且尚未充分发挥创建社区的潜力。这就是Marimekko想要实现的目标。

Marimekko希望站在这一新运动的前沿，向其他行业参与者展示拥有充满活力的社区的力量。

预计到2028年，二手市场将超过快时尚，但我们将这一小众市场转变为主流市场还有很长的路要走。因此，时尚品牌必须成为这一过程中的积极推动者，以支持循环价值链的发展，并确保他们的社区仍然保持参与和活跃。

Marimekko如何促进和使社区成员能够以流畅的过程和卓越的体验互动和交换二手Marimekko物品？我们希望这个平台作为一个活跃的Marimekko社区助推器，所以人们总是为了新内容而回来对我们来说也很重要！
insights_zh:
平台应包含哪些元素和其他功能，以将消费者体验提升到极致，同时让他们有机会购买他们喜爱的印花和服装？Marimekko的未来平台与现有的多品牌市场相比有何独特之处，并赋予其魅力？

这个挑战为您提供了独特的机会，完全沉浸在时尚世界中，摆脱所有束缚，在Marimekko的支持下创造全新的事物。
resources_zh: 活动期间，Marimekko将有导师协助您，如果您对挑战有任何疑问。

Description:
This weekend, we invite you to use the Miro platform to expand on our mission and empower your own audience to create and collaborate in today’s world.

We’ve been working on some new things for our platform, and for this challenge, you’ll have access to a preview of what’s coming. The Miro platform includes both a Web SDK and a REST API. The Miro Web SDK allows you to interact with a board inside of Miro, even creating custom applications. The Miro REST API allows you to pull information from and pass information to a board, which supports creating integrations both with the Web SDK or with any other application you may have. You can use one or both of these tools to create your solution that helps teams build the next big thing.

We want you to show us what you’ve got. Feel free to create something entirely new, or to take an existing concept and apply it in a new way.
Insights: Miro’s infinite canvas empowers more than 20M users to brainstorm, map ideas, build a plan, and generally just work — whether they are sitting at the same conference table or collaborating across continents. This challenge offers you the opportunity to build integrations that could improve the workday for millions of people. You can aim to make something for the everyday user, or to create an integration that an enterprise could install for every employee. We welcome your creativity, and we look forward to seeing what you will do.
Resources: During the event, you’ll be using a developer preview of the Miro platform. We’ll have a getting-started guide for participants to browse once the event begins.\n\nWe understand that a developer preview may introduce some unexpected challenges. So we will have a team of mentors available for office hours during the following times. In addition, we may have bonus support late at night or early in the morning, and we will be sure to post those extra times as they come up.
description_zh:
这个周末，我们邀请您使用 Miro 平台来拓展我们的使命，并赋能您自己的受众在当今世界中创建和协作。

我们一直在为平台开发一些新功能，本次挑战中，您将可以预览即将推出的内容。Miro 平台包含 Web SDK 和 REST API。Miro Web SDK 允许您在 Miro 内部与看板交互，甚至创建自定义应用。Miro REST API 允许您从看板拉取信息并向看板传递信息，支持通过 Web SDK 或您拥有的任何其他应用创建集成。您可以使用其中一个或两个工具来创建解决方案，帮助团队构建下一个重大创新。

我们希望您向我们展示您的实力。请随意创建全新内容，或将现有概念以新方式应用。
insights_zh: Miro 的无限画布赋能超过 2000 万用户进行头脑风暴、梳理思路、制定计划以及日常协作——无论他们是坐在同一张会议桌旁，还是跨洲协作。本次挑战为您提供了构建集成的机会，这些集成可以改善数百万人的日常工作。您可以致力于为日常用户打造产品，或创建企业可为每位员工安装的集成。我们欢迎您的创造力，并期待看到您的成果。
resources_zh: 活动期间，您将使用 Miro 平台的开发者预览版。活动开始后，我们将为参与者提供一份入门指南供浏览。\n\n我们理解开发者预览版可能会带来一些意外挑战。因此，我们将在以下时间段安排导师团队提供办公时间。此外，我们可能在深夜或清晨提供额外支持，并会在这些额外时间确定后及时发布。

Description:
With ever more data publicly available, it is increasingly possible to calculate carbon footprints, and other forms of environmental impact, caused by computing and data infrastructure, with higher accuracy and scope. 

Computers consume a lot of electricity, on a truly global scale, and much of that consumption happens in data centers around the world. Thanks to cloud native technologies, the threshold has never been lower to migrate between cloud providers. We are asking you to help us make it easier for others to choose the most sustainable way to run their data infrastructure.

Can you find a way to allow people to visualise how their choices affect the environment? The goal is to enable “environmental competition” for consumers - to compare services and goods, not only by their price, but also by their burden on the environment.

The challenge is to come up with a tool that provides comprehensible and insightful feedback about the environmental impact of people's choices, for historically recorded data, and also to enable future predictions. You should make it easy to integrate with other services and websites.
Insights: Please focus on using multiple, accurate information sources. For maximum impact, try to provide not only the end results, but also show how they were reached. Make it possible for users to tinker with the initial assumptions, and fetch the data for their own further use.
Resources:
The Aiven team is here to help you.

Some people hate working with operations and maintenance, but we love it. We at Aiven are leaders in cloud-based open source data infrastructure solutions: databases, message queues, fault-tolerant storage, and much more. With our help, developers can do what they do best: create awesome applications. Meanwhile, we do what we do best: manage cloud data infrastructure. 

During the event, Aiven will offer you free infrastructure (in the form of credits) and expert advice for building your data processing pipeline. Our easy, API-based service provisioning will help you automate the setup of your infrastructure - and we can help you with that too.
description_zh:
随着公开可用的数据越来越多，我们越来越有可能以更高的准确性和更广的范围来计算由计算和数据基础设施产生的碳足迹及其他形式的环境影响。

计算机在全球范围内消耗大量电力，其中大部分消耗发生在世界各地的数据中心。得益于云原生技术，迁移云提供商的阈值从未如此之低。我们请求你帮助我们让其他人更容易选择最可持续的方式来运行他们的数据基础设施。

你能否找到一种方法，让人们可视化他们的选择如何影响环境？目标是实现消费者的“环境竞争”——不仅根据价格，还根据对环境的负担来比较服务和商品。

挑战在于提出一种工具，能够针对历史记录数据，提供关于人们选择的环境影响的易懂且有洞察力的反馈，并支持未来预测。你应该使其易于与其他服务和网站集成。
insights_zh: 请专注于使用多个准确的信息来源。为了获得最大影响，尝试不仅提供最终结果，还展示它们是如何得出的。让用户能够调整初始假设，并获取数据以供自己进一步使用。
resources_zh:
Aiven 团队随时为你提供帮助。

有些人讨厌从事运维工作，但我们热爱它。Aiven 是云原生开源数据基础设施解决方案的领导者：数据库、消息队列、容错存储等等。在我们的帮助下，开发者可以做他们最擅长的事：创建出色的应用程序。同时，我们做我们最擅长的事：管理云数据基础设施。

活动期间，Aiven 将为你提供免费基础设施（以积分形式）和专家建议，用于构建你的数据处理管道。我们基于 API 的简易服务配置将帮助你自动化基础设施的设置——我们也可以在这方面帮助你。

Description:
In this challenge, we ask you to utilise, apply and visualise the sensor data to understand the use of the building and to improve applying the sensor network optimally in the building in the first place. You can select one or all three of the parts of the challenge to work on.

Where are all the devices?
We typically spend a lot of effort on identifying and positioning a large number of sensors on a floorplan. Can we simplify the process, and use the data from a subset of the sensors to automatically place the rest on a floorplan?

Where is everyone going?
Motion sensors are useful in determining the amount of activity in a space. We also know what kind of space it is, for example, a hallway or a corridor. Can we identify what are the most used pathways in a building, given the hundreds of thousands of motion events the sensors are generating?

Mystery Garage
There are moving vehicles and pedestrians in a garage. We have motion and audio sensors. Can we identify what is happening in the garage? Are there vehicles coming in or going out? Are pedestrians walking towards the elevators, or getting in their cars?
Resources:
We will provide layouts of the different floorplans containing device locations and time-series of motion and audio events.

Datasets:
BUILDINGS The participants are given datasets from indoor premises. The data will be completely anonymised. The floorplans will contain devices and their locations. The dataset will be a time series of motion events from all the sensors on the floorplan.

GARAGE The participants are given a training dataset from an indoor garage, collected using motion and audio sensors. 

You are encouraged to use other data sources and feel free to use data from/combine your ideas with other Junction challenges if you see a fit.
name_zh: 更明亮的空间：智能照明
description_zh:
在这个挑战中，我们要求您利用、应用和可视化传感器数据，以了解建筑的使用情况，并优化传感器网络在建筑中的初始部署。您可以选择挑战的三个部分中的一个或全部进行工作。

所有设备在哪里？
我们通常花费大量精力在平面图上识别和定位大量传感器。我们能否简化这个过程，并利用一部分传感器的数据自动将其余传感器放置在平面图上？

每个人要去哪里？
运动传感器有助于确定空间中的活动量。我们也知道空间的类型，例如走廊或通道。鉴于传感器生成数十万个运动事件，我们能否识别建筑物中使用最频繁的路径？

神秘车库
车库中有移动的车辆和行人。我们有运动传感器和音频传感器。我们能否识别车库中正在发生的事情？是否有车辆进出？行人是走向电梯，还是上车？
resources_zh:
我们将提供不同平面图的布局，包含设备位置以及运动和音频事件的时间序列。

数据集：
建筑物：参与者将获得来自室内场所的数据集。数据将完全匿名化。平面图将包含设备及其位置。数据集将是平面图上所有传感器的运动事件时间序列。

车库：参与者将获得来自室内车库的训练数据集，使用运动和音频传感器收集。

鼓励您使用其他数据源，并随时使用来自其他Junction挑战的数据或将您的想法与其他挑战结合，如果您认为合适。

Description:
Living alone is increasing. Last year more than 1.2 million Finns lived alone. That’s almost 45 percent of housing communities. Those who are living alone and experience loneliness, have in common high age, low income and poor health. (According to Statistics Finland)
In this challenge we are looking for solutions to preventing social isolation and loneliness. How could we recommend needs-based services to a person living alone?
Advancing well-being and developing health services are included in Turku’s Mayor program. The city is gradually investing in preventive services and strengthening service guidance so that customers can easily and smoothly find the right service at the right time. At the same time Turku is exploring the possibilities of increasing at home services for the elderly.
One question to start with could be: how could the digital services provided by the city be combined with those offered by other service providers?
Help us to find innovative solutions for recommending needs-based services to an elderly person left alone, for example through advanced machine learning algorithms.
Insights: During the event, participants will be creating new innovative solutions and services using real world data and proprietary APIs. We are also bringing mentors with years of experience.\nWhat we'll bring:\nMachine readable sources that you can use
Judging criteria: We appreciate solutions which are functional and valuable, innovative and also implementable. Our team focuses on the following criteria: Design, originality, impact and utility.
Prizes: 1st place: 1 500€\n2nd place: 750 €
description_zh:
独居现象日益增多。去年，超过120万芬兰人独居，这几乎占了住房社区的45%。那些独居且感到孤独的人，通常具有高龄、低收入和健康状况不佳的共同特征。（根据芬兰统计局数据）
在本挑战中，我们正在寻找预防社会隔离和孤独的解决方案。我们如何向独居者推荐基于需求的服务？
促进福祉和发展健康服务是图尔库市长计划的一部分。该市正在逐步投资于预防性服务，并加强服务指导，以便客户能够轻松顺利地找到正确的服务。同时，图尔库正在探索增加老年人居家服务的可能性。
首先可以提出的一个问题是：如何将城市提供的数字服务与其他服务提供商提供的服务结合起来？
帮助我们找到创新的解决方案，为独居老人推荐基于需求的服务，例如通过先进的机器学习算法。
insights_zh:
活动期间，参与者将使用真实世界数据和专有API创建新的创新解决方案和服务。我们还带来了拥有多年经验的导师。
我们将提供：
可供您使用的机器可读数据源
judging_criteria_zh: 我们欣赏功能实用且有价值、创新且可实施的解决方案。我们的团队关注以下标准：设计、原创性、影响力和实用性。
prizes_zh:
第一名：1500欧元
第二名：750欧元

Description:
All of us use water every day for many purposes. Yet, we might not know where the water is used the most, and more importantly, how it should be used: People should know the amount of water they use in shower or what is a reasonable amount
Building owners could predict the need of hot water and optimize the heating process
In hand washing, a long soaping time (up to 20 sec) is crucial to get all the microbes away
In big buildings it´s important for plumbers to quickly identify the location of the leaking faucet
What data and insights could be visualized and how should it need to be displayed? How can we make every user more conscious about their water usage and encourage them to do better? Information could be transformed into targets or even positive competition via gamification, resulting in doing good for the users and our environment.
Insights: Water is present all the time in our everyday lives. Still, many of us pay very little attention to the usage of it. We want to improve the tracking of this very important nature asset. \n\nThe goal is to provide insights and encouragement for the users to improve themselves  - similar to what heart rate monitors did for running or Oura ring has lately done for sleeping.
Resources: During the event, we will provide proprietary water usage data in JSON-format from one building including 20 apartments for the contenders. Our experts are supporting and mentoring throughout the event. Also the latest developments of our product offering such as digital hand shower and touchless Bluetooth faucets are presented at our booth and online at Oras Hydractiva Digital - Save water and energy in the shower and SMART faucets (oras.com)
Links: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/13Fw39EVsbINbzRHSzVxi3Lf0qX_uhUByfFim1IhWvcU/edit#slide=id.g12f60a4460b_0_16
description_zh:
我们每天都在为各种目的使用水。然而，我们可能不知道水在哪些方面使用最多，更重要的是，应该如何用水：人们应该知道他们在淋浴时用了多少水，或者多少是合理的用水量
建筑业主可以预测热水需求并优化加热过程
在洗手时，长时间的皂液搓洗（长达20秒）对于去除所有微生物至关重要
在大型建筑中，水管工快速识别漏水龙头的位置非常重要
哪些数据和洞察可以被可视化，以及应该如何展示？我们如何让每个用户更加意识到他们的用水情况，并鼓励他们做得更好？信息可以转化为目标，甚至通过游戏化实现良性竞争，从而为用户和环境带来好处。
insights_zh:
水始终存在于我们的日常生活中。然而，我们中的许多人对水的使用却很少关注。我们希望改善对这一非常重要自然资产的追踪。

目标是提供洞察和鼓励，帮助用户自我改进——类似于心率监测器对跑步所做的，或Oura戒指最近对睡眠所做的。
resources_zh: 活动期间，我们将为参赛者提供来自一栋包含20套公寓的建筑物的专有用水数据，格式为JSON。我们的专家将在整个活动期间提供支持和指导。此外，我们产品系列的最新发展，如数字手持花洒和免接触蓝牙水龙头，将在我们的展位以及线上展示：Oras Hydractiva Digital - 在淋浴中节约水和能源，以及SMART水龙头 (oras.com)
links_zh: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/13Fw39EVsbINbzRHSzVxi3Lf0qX_uhUByfFim1IhWvcU/edit#slide=id.g12f60a4460b_0_16

Description: We want you to create an innovative solution to help young adults with their mental health and wellbeing. It should be something original, that you can't find a dozen solutions to with a simple Google search. Your project should take the specific needs of the users into consideration, be convenient to use, and provide insights that could help prevent mental health problems or aid with ongoing struggles.
Insights: It can be purely for individual use, include collaboration tools with peers, or it can involve healthcare professionals in some way. Because we would be dealing with personal information we want the security and privacy to be top notch! And using juicy technologies such as Rust, serverless, AI or AR is optional, but appreciated!
Resources: Reaktor mentors will be on-site and ready to answer all your questions!
Judging criteria: The qualities we are looking for are: Considerate design, Innovative ideas, Ability to provide valuable insights, Security and privacy, Working software
Prizes: 1st place: a long weekend in one of Reaktor's European office cities for the whole team. The experience includes flights, accommodation, and a tour of Reaktor's office. 2nd place: Reaktor backpacks full of Reaktor swag + 300€ Amazon gift card. 3rd place: Reaktor backpacks full of Reaktor swag + 200€ Amazon gift card
description_zh: 我们希望你能创建一个创新解决方案，帮助年轻人应对心理健康和福祉问题。它应该是原创的，不能通过简单的谷歌搜索找到一堆类似方案。你的项目应考虑用户的具体需求，使用便捷，并提供有助于预防心理健康问题或帮助应对持续困扰的洞察。
insights_zh: 它可以纯粹供个人使用，包含与同伴的协作工具，或以某种方式涉及医疗保健专业人员。由于我们将处理个人信息，我们希望安全性和隐私达到顶级水平！使用Rust、无服务器、AI或AR等有趣的技术是可选的，但会受到赞赏！
judging_criteria_zh: 我们寻找的品质是：体贴的设计、创新的想法、提供有价值洞察的能力、安全与隐私、可工作的软件
prizes_zh: 第一名：整个团队在Reaktor欧洲办公城市之一享受长周末。体验包括航班、住宿和Reaktor办公室参观。第二名：装满Reaktor周边产品的Reaktor背包 + 300欧元亚马逊礼品卡。第三名：装满Reaktor周边产品的Reaktor背包 + 200欧元亚马逊礼品卡
resources_zh: Reaktor导师将在现场，随时回答你的所有问题！

Description: Being one of the top crypto market makers and helping to improve the efficiency in the crypto space with various in-house solutions to keep track on the markets both in micro and macro levels, we see that there are many different solutions for different trading bots / helpers in different areas, but none of the ones existing have found an optimal solution to help companies like us to precisely measure the trends, volumes, different signals in the market or even twitter sentiment.
Insights: We are a global crypto liquidity provider and algorithmic market maker. We trade digital assets listed on more than 25 Centralized Exchanges across the globe. Trading around 0.8% of worlds Crypto spot volume.
Judging criteria: The most important thing we are looking for is a technical solution/idea and concrete steps to make it go live. We are looking for a different perspectives of the market and different data sources that could be implemented to determine better pricing.
Prizes: The winning team will receive a prize of 2 ETH.\\n\\nThe first runner up will get a prize of 0.5 ETH.
description_zh: 作为顶级的加密货币做市商之一，我们通过多种内部解决方案帮助提升加密货币领域的效率，以在微观和宏观层面跟踪市场。我们看到，不同领域存在许多针对不同交易机器人/助手的解决方案，但现有方案中没有一个能帮助像我们这样的公司精确衡量市场趋势、交易量、不同信号甚至 Twitter 情绪的最优解。
insights_zh: 我们是一家全球加密货币流动性提供商和算法做市商。我们在全球超过 25 家中心化交易所交易数字资产。交易量约占全球加密货币现货交易量的 0.8%。
judging_criteria_zh: 我们最看重的是技术解决方案/想法以及使其上线的具体步骤。我们正在寻找对市场的不同视角以及可用于确定更好定价的不同数据源。
prizes_zh:
获胜团队将获得 2 ETH 的奖金。

亚军将获得 0.5 ETH 的奖金。

Description: We have traveled 200 years in time because we need your help. We have become multi-planetary, we rule the galaxy, and yet here we are, fighting with each other like the old times. We can’t get governance working, the federations keep fighting. Money still gets printed like paper by careless leaders who just want to rule a moon. Our trade ships were Ion-blasted away by pirates, our treasures were lost or sold in black markets. We need your help. How can we manage such large distances, time dilation, and differences in resources, cultural and societal goals between all the human settlements? How can we ensure liberty without tyranny?\\n\\nEnvision the tools of tomorrow so we can start building them today.\\n\\nThere are rumors of a side quest too, a hidden treasure floats in space, ready to be claimed by adventurers like you, the first one to find and break it open gets it.
Resources: During Junction, a few of our time travelers will be on the premises to guide and mentor you. Feel free to ask questions and validate your ideas
Judging criteria: We are looking for solutions that might solve our problems but if you can implement something and show you can execute your vision, that's what makes a winner.
Prizes: 8,000€ in prizes:1st place 3000€ worth of ETH or euros, 2nd place 2000€ worth of ETH or euros, 3rd place 1000€ worth of ETH or euros. The pirate treasure side quest (treasure location to be announced at the start of the event): 2000€ worth of ETH or euros)
description_zh:
我们穿越了200年时光，因为我们需要你的帮助。我们已成为多行星物种，统治着银河系，然而如今我们却像旧时代一样互相争斗。治理机制无法运转，联邦之间战火不断。不负责任的领导人只想统治一颗卫星，金钱仍像纸张一样被随意印造。我们的贸易飞船被海盗的离子炮击毁，财宝或遗失或在黑市被变卖。我们需要你的帮助。我们该如何管理如此遥远的距离、时间膨胀，以及所有人类定居点之间在资源、文化和社会目标上的差异？我们如何在避免暴政的同时确保自由？

构想明天的工具，以便我们今天就开始建造它们。

还有传言说存在一个支线任务：太空中漂浮着一份隐藏的宝藏，等待像你这样的冒险者去认领，第一个找到并打开它的人将获得它。
judging_criteria_zh: 我们寻找的是可能解决我们问题的方案，但如果你能实现一些东西并证明你能执行你的愿景，那才是造就赢家的关键。
prizes_zh: 总奖金8,000欧元：第一名价值3000欧元的ETH或欧元，第二名价值2000欧元的ETH或欧元，第三名价值1000欧元的ETH或欧元。海盗宝藏支线任务（宝藏位置将在活动开始时公布）：价值2000欧元的ETH或欧元。
resources_zh: 在Junction活动期间，我们的几位时间旅行者将到场指导和辅导你。欢迎随时提问并验证你的想法。

Description: Even as you read this, your data is probably spreading to servers around the world in exchange for some cookies that you can't even eat. Although we are aware that our data is being sold to unknown actors, we lack the proper tools to control the situation. Web3 can give that power back to the people.
Insights: Your challenge is to come up with a business model or application that combines Web3 principles, such as data ownership and monetization, with Streamr’s Data Unions framework. Using Streamr’s network is optional.\\n\\nWhy would people or organizations want to share their data in your economy, and why would someone buy the data? How would you ensure each member gets their fair share and what other means of incentivization exist besides money? These are questions you might ask yourself during the hackathon. Any material that can strengthen your business case, like a prototype, is welcome.\\n\\nTaking part in this challenge will help you understand the new business models created by Web3. In addition, you will gain hands-on knowledge in using blockchain technology that powers decentralized networks.
Resources: The mentors from TX and Streamr will help your frame your business proposals and get a grasp of blockchain technology. All the relevant technical material is available online on Streamr's website. We have also set up a [knowledge page] (https://tx.company/blog/tx-streamr-web3-challenge-junction-2022/) to help you get started
Judging criteria: We will examine the feasibility of your concept and how it may promote sustainable economic and social values. We encourage you to find an innovative approach to the challenge rather than reinventing an existing idea. We also appreciate your ability to demonstrate the concept (demo, mockup, prototype, something else). Utility, feasibility and user value 40%, Innovativeness & novelty 20%, Overall quality and detail of work 30%, Presentation 10%
Prizes: 1st place: 3000€ in DATA tokens, 2nd place: 1500€ in DATA tokens, 3rd place: 500€ in DATA tokens
name_zh: 公平且合乎道德的数据业务
description_zh: 即使在你阅读这段文字时，你的数据可能正以一些你甚至不能吃的饼干为代价，传播到世界各地的服务器上。尽管我们意识到自己的数据正被出售给未知的行为者，但我们缺乏适当的工具来控制局面。Web3 可以将这种权力归还给人民。
insights_zh:
你的挑战是提出一种商业模式或应用，将 Web3 原则（如数据所有权和货币化）与 Streamr 的 Data Unions 框架相结合。使用 Streamr 的网络是可选的。

为什么人们或组织愿意在你的经济中分享他们的数据？为什么有人会购买这些数据？你将如何确保每个成员获得公平的份额？除了金钱之外，还有哪些激励手段？这些是你在黑客松期间可以思考的问题。欢迎提供任何能强化你商业案例的材料，例如原型。

参与这个挑战将帮助你理解 Web3 创造的新商业模式。此外，你将获得使用驱动去中心化网络的区块链技术的实践经验。
judging_criteria_zh: 我们将评估你概念的可行性以及它如何促进可持续的经济和社会价值。我们鼓励你寻找创新的方法来应对挑战，而不是重新发明现有的想法。我们也欣赏你展示概念的能力（演示、模型、原型或其他形式）。实用性、可行性和用户价值 40%，创新性和新颖性 20%，工作的整体质量和细节 30%，展示 10%
prizes_zh: 第一名：3000€ 的 DATA 代币，第二名：1500€ 的 DATA 代币，第三名：500€ 的 DATA 代币
resources_zh: 来自 TX 和 Streamr 的导师将帮助你构建商业提案并掌握区块链技术。所有相关技术材料均可在 Streamr 的网站上在线获取。我们还设置了一个[知识页面](https://tx.company/blog/tx-streamr-web3-challenge-junction-2022/)来帮助你入门

Challenge name: Digitally Empowering Consumers in the Face of a Global Energy Crisis
Description: Last year, BCG established two moonshots – AI and Climate & Sustainability. Having these moonshots means that we, as a leading management consultancy, invest in building the best capabilities on the market to help our clients solve challenges relating to AI and sustainability, and the offered task goes in line with the company's innovative goals.\\n\\nWe challenge you to find new innovative digital or advanced analytics solutions to reduce or optimize the energy consumption of individuals and businesses. The solution can be either a tool or a prototype of a methodology.\\n\\nThe solution can be created with the technology of choice and can involve any open-source data.
Resources: We will provide you with: Datasets and links to useful data sources. Especially those relating to energy consumption in Finland and the electrical consumption levels for different household appliances. The CO2.AI Product description and example use cases for inspiration. BCG Gamma and Platinion mentors with expertise in sustainability and AI topics who can help you with framing and branding your solution.
Judging criteria: We are looking for concrete solutions to reduce energy usage. Alongside effectiveness in reducing or optimizing electricity usage, the solutions are judged by their innovativeness, ease of implementation, and likelihood of adoption.
Prizes: 1st place: 2000 € Amazon gift card, 2nd place 1000 € Amazon gift card, 3rd place: 500 € Amazon gift card
name_zh: 在全球能源危机中数字化赋能消费者
description_zh:
去年，BCG确立了两大登月计划——人工智能与气候和可持续发展。拥有这些登月计划意味着，作为领先的管理咨询公司，我们投资建设市场上最佳的能力，帮助客户解决与人工智能和可持续发展相关的挑战，而所提供的任务与公司的创新目标一致。

我们挑战你寻找新的创新数字或高级分析解决方案，以减少或优化个人和企业的能源消耗。解决方案可以是一个工具或方法论的雏形。

解决方案可以使用任选技术创建，并可涉及任何开源数据。
judging_criteria_zh: 我们正在寻找减少能源使用的具体解决方案。除了在减少或优化电力使用方面的有效性外，解决方案还将根据其创新性、实施难易度和采用可能性进行评判。
prizes_zh: 第一名：2000欧元亚马逊礼品卡，第二名：1000欧元亚马逊礼品卡，第三名：500欧元亚马逊礼品卡
resources_zh: 我们将为你提供：数据集和有用数据源的链接。特别是与芬兰能源消耗以及不同家用电器电力消耗水平相关的数据。CO2.AI产品描述和示例用例以供启发。BCG Gamma和Platinion的导师，他们在可持续发展和人工智能主题方面具有专业知识，可以帮助你构建和品牌化你的解决方案。

Description: Much of Europe is massively dependent on Russia in terms of energy needs, and in the current state of affairs, the situation is far from ideal. Finland, in particular, used to import 100% of all and cutting these imports would be a deadly blow to our current energy infrastructure. Being self-sufficient in the energy sector feels impossible, but it doesn’t have to be. With creativity, quick thinking, and the will to act, we could be free from imported energy — if not from everywhere, at least from Russia.\\n\\nGermany relies on Russia for almost half of its gas supply and has recently had to limit gas use in electricity production. The government has had to appeal to citizens to conserve energy after Moscow cut some supplies, Al Jazeera and the Financial Times report. The supply disruption is also forcing Germany to use more coal-fired power plants. In Finland, the electricity supply might not be enough to cover demand, especially for the coming winter.
Insights: This is our challenge to you: re-imagine how Finland or any country in Europe produces and/or uses energy to bring us one step closer to energy independence. To reduce our dependency, it seems we must either use less energy, use it more efficiently, or produce more of it ourselves. How could we produce energy ourselves? Could we store energy smartly? Are there sources of energy we're not using to the fullest? Are there processes that waste energy that could be utilized somehow? Your solution could be, for example: A digital solution for optimizing energy production, consumption, and integration side of energy. An automation and control system for buildings to integrate and optimize demand response, consumption prediction, energy storage, and management of distributed energy. A new way of city planning, such as how to centralize energy generated by solar panels, how to manage demand and supply, or how to manage electric vehicle charging stations. A smarter system to optimize the heating and cooling system in buildings to utilize energy in a smarter way — think about university buildings, for example! A system to change people's behavior, such as incentivizing the use of public transportation during rush hour or when energy prices differ. We’re especially looking for solutions individuals or organizations could implement rather quickly — if your solution is to build a new nuclear power plant, you’d better have an innovative plan to set it up in less than 12 months.
Judging criteria: Innovation: Is the idea/concept/prototype/technology new or different compared to existing ones?  Does the idea/concept/prototype or some parts of it distinguish it somehow from existing\\nones? Impact: Does the idea/concept/prototype have a significant impact on society through solving the problem(s) it addresses? Does the idea/concept/prototype have a significant impact on the majority of the people facing the problem it solves? How large is the ratio between the number of people whose problem got solved compared to the total number of people affected by the problem? How scalable is the solution? Is it solving problems at the city level, country level, or global level? Implementation: Is the idea/concept/prototype eventually realistic, viable, and feasible to be implemented from all perspectives, such as: no Business aspects\\no Social acceptability\\no Recyclability of energy, How quickly the solution can be implemented?
Prizes: The winning team will receive 1000€ prize divided among the team members as stipends
description_zh: 欧洲许多国家在能源需求上严重依赖俄罗斯，在当前局势下，情况远非理想。特别是芬兰，过去曾100%进口所有能源，切断这些进口将对我们当前的能源基础设施造成致命打击。在能源领域实现自给自足似乎是不可能的，但并非必须如此。凭借创造力、快速思考和行动意愿，我们可以摆脱进口能源——即使不是从所有地方，至少可以从俄罗斯。\n\n德国近一半的天然气供应依赖俄罗斯，最近不得不限制天然气用于电力生产。据半岛电视台和《金融时报》报道，在莫斯科削减部分供应后，政府不得不呼吁公民节约能源。供应中断也迫使德国使用更多燃煤电厂。在芬兰，电力供应可能不足以满足需求，尤其是即将到来的冬季。
insights_zh: 这是我们给你的挑战：重新构想芬兰或欧洲任何国家如何生产和/或使用能源，让我们离能源独立更近一步。为了减少依赖，我们似乎必须要么减少能源使用，要么更高效地使用能源，要么自己生产更多能源。我们如何自己生产能源？我们能否智能地储存能源？是否有我们未充分利用的能源来源？是否有浪费能源的过程可以以某种方式加以利用？你的解决方案可以是，例如：一个用于优化能源生产、消费和整合方面的数字解决方案。一个用于建筑的自动化和控制系统，以整合和优化需求响应、消费预测、能源储存和分布式能源管理。一种新的城市规划方式，例如如何集中太阳能电池板产生的能源，如何管理需求和供应，或如何管理电动汽车充电站。一个更智能的系统来优化建筑的供暖和制冷系统，以更智能的方式利用能源——想想大学建筑！一个改变人们行为的系统，例如激励在高峰时段或能源价格不同时使用公共交通。我们尤其寻找个人或组织可以相当快速实施的解决方案——如果你的解决方案是建造一座新的核电站，你最好有一个在12个月内建成的创新计划。
judging_criteria_zh: 创新性：与现有想法/概念/原型/技术相比，该想法/概念/原型/技术是否新颖或不同？该想法/概念/原型或其部分是否以某种方式与现有想法/概念/原型区分开来？影响力：该想法/概念/原型是否通过解决其所针对的问题对社会产生重大影响？该想法/概念/原型是否对面临其所解决问题的大多数人产生重大影响？问题得到解决的人数与受问题影响的总人数之间的比例有多大？解决方案的可扩展性如何？它是在城市层面、国家层面还是全球层面解决问题？实施性：该想法/概念/原型最终是否现实、可行，并从所有角度（如：无商业方面、无社会可接受性、能源可回收性）来看是可行的？解决方案实施的速度有多快？
prizes_zh: 获胜团队将获得1000欧元奖金，作为津贴分发给团队成员

Description: “Do or do not. There is no try." The IT industry's share of global electricity consumption is currently 5-9%. There are predictions that it will rise to as much as 21% by 2030. So in the IT field we have more and more responsibility for the energy consumption of systems. Green Coding is greener approach to implement and run software.
Insights: “Always pass on what you have learned.” This challenge is about innovating ways to implement applications in a more energy-efficient manner. Energy-efficient solutions can include things like avoiding unnecessary processing, optimizing capacity use, using energy-efficient programming languages, using energy-efficient file formats, the application can have an eco-mode, screen color choices can influence energy consumption and so on. The task is to design and implement a simple media site that presents different kinds of content such as blog posts, images and video clips. The solution should include data storage for the content, a backend service and a frontend for the user interface.
Resources: “You will find only what you bring in.” You are free to choose the technologies to be used but the solution should be as energy efficient as possible.
Judging criteria: The solutions are scored as follows: Service design and UX (0-25 points): How energy consumption is taken into account in service design?,  What kind of options are offered to users to make climate-friendly choices?, Technical design and architecture (0-25 points) Energy efficiency of technology choices: How energy consumption is taken into account in architecture? Implementation (0-25 points): How energy-efficient the implementation is?Metrics (0-25 points): How you measure energy efficiency of the solution?
Prizes: 1st Place: 2000€, 2nd Place: 1000€
description_zh: “做或不做。没有尝试。” IT行业目前占全球电力消耗的5-9%。有预测称，到2030年这一比例将上升至21%。因此，在IT领域，我们对系统的能源消耗负有越来越大的责任。绿色编码是一种更环保的实现和运行软件的方法。
insights_zh: “永远传递你所学到的。” 本挑战旨在创新以更节能的方式实现应用程序的方法。节能解决方案可以包括避免不必要的处理、优化容量使用、使用节能编程语言、使用节能文件格式、应用程序可以具有生态模式、屏幕颜色选择可以影响能耗等等。任务是设计并实现一个简单的媒体网站，展示博客文章、图片和视频剪辑等不同类型的内容。解决方案应包括内容的数据存储、后端服务和用户界面的前端。
judging_criteria_zh: 解决方案评分如下：服务设计与用户体验（0-25分）：服务设计中如何考虑能源消耗？为用户提供了哪些选项以做出气候友好型选择？技术设计与架构（0-25分）：技术选择的能源效率：架构中如何考虑能源消耗？实现（0-25分）：实现的节能程度如何？指标（0-25分）：如何衡量解决方案的能源效率？
prizes_zh: 第一名：2000欧元，第二名：1000欧元
resources_zh: “你只能带入你所带来的。” 您可以自由选择使用的技术，但解决方案应尽可能节能。

Description: At Wolt, we’re on a mission to make cities better places to live. Our vision is big — the whole city delivered to you, within minutes. And to get there, we’re building new infrastructure — a commerce platform to seamlessly connect our millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of merchant and courier partners, in real-time across 23 countries and 250+ cities.\\n\\nWe believe that our platform can be used to not just make cities better places to live, but also help us to build a more sustainable future. We’ve already invested a lot into sustainability of our business, but how could we use the technology powering Wolt to further improve sustainability of cities? Considering trends like sharing economy and sustainable living, while thinking beyond things like secondhand or emissions, what could be the revolutionary opportunities Wolt deliveries could enable? This is where you come in. We’d love to see your ideas to innovate how we can make cities more sustainable through the use of our Wolt DriveAPI.\\n\\nAPI repository: https://github.com/woltapp/junction-2022-materials\\n\\n. Read more about our sustainability efforts so far: https://wolt.com/en/responsibility\\n\\nFind out more about Wolt Drive: https://wolt.com/en/drive
Insights: We’ll give you access to the Wolt Drive API in our test environment. You’ll be able to request a (simulated) delivery from any pickup location to any drop off location by using the delivery order endpoint (POST/merchants/{merchant_id}/delivery-order) of the API.Please visit our stand to get the API credentials and other required information.
Judging criteria: We value innovation, so we’d encourage you to think outside the box. In addition to a creative and unique idea, we’d like to see a working technical prototype which uses the Wolt DriveAPI. 50% of the overall assessment comes from the idea and 50% from the implementation.
Prizes: 1st place: 2500€ worth of Wolt credits, 2nd place: 1000€ worth of Wolt credits, 3rd place: 500€ worth of Wolt credits
name_zh: 更好的城市。由我们送达。
description_zh:
在 Wolt，我们的使命是让城市成为更宜居的地方。我们的愿景宏大——整个城市，几分钟内送达。为了实现这一目标，我们正在构建新的基础设施——一个商务平台，实时无缝连接数百万客户与数十万商家和配送合作伙伴，覆盖 23 个国家、250 多个城市。

我们相信，我们的平台不仅能用于让城市更宜居，还能帮助我们构建更可持续的未来。我们已经在业务可持续性方面投入了大量资源，但如何利用驱动 Wolt 的技术来进一步改善城市的可持续性？考虑到共享经济和可持续生活等趋势，同时超越二手或排放等范畴，Wolt 配送能带来哪些革命性机遇？这就是你的用武之地。我们很乐意看到你的创意，通过使用我们的 Wolt DriveAPI 来创新如何让城市更可持续。

API 仓库：https://github.com/woltapp/junction-2022-materials

了解更多我们迄今为止的可持续发展努力：https://wolt.com/en/responsibility

了解更多关于 Wolt Drive 的信息：https://wolt.com/en/drive
insights_zh: 我们将为你提供测试环境中的 Wolt Drive API 访问权限。你可以使用 API 的配送订单端点（POST/merchants/{merchant_id}/delivery-order）从任意取货地点到任意送货地点请求（模拟）配送。请访问我们的展台获取 API 凭证和其他所需信息。
judging_criteria_zh: 我们重视创新，因此鼓励你跳出框框思考。除了创意独特且富有创造力的想法外，我们还希望看到使用 Wolt DriveAPI 的可运行技术原型。总体评估的 50% 来自想法，50% 来自实现。
prizes_zh: 第一名：价值 2500 欧元的 Wolt 积分，第二名：价值 1000 欧元的 Wolt 积分，第三名：价值 500 欧元的 Wolt 积分

Description: The foundation for Huawei success for the past 30 years is the focus on technological and engineering innovations driven by consumer needs, listed as the sixth most innovative company in the world by Boston Consulting Group (BCG). Moving forward Huawei will pursue the innovation driven by the consumer needs along with the shared vision for the future to achieve technological leadership along with the world.
Insights: Mobile apps are essential technologies for digital innovation which can be achieved by putting knowledge to work in creating apps to solve real-life problems. During Junction 2022, they're challenging our participants to build a prototype mobile app/game that implements innovative ideas about remote working, using the recommended Huawei Mobile Service SDKs.\\n\\nThe mobile app or game does not have to be complex in order to be effective. The app or game should try to solve real life problems about remote work. The app must include one of the recommended HMS SKD to qualify. See more about HMS Core: https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/en/develop/
Resources: On-site mentors to assist during the challenge. Huawei HMS test devices and test developer accounts. Huawei Mobile Services starter projects for Native Android, React Native and Flutter, APIs links and documents.
Judging criteria: Rating rules: Total score (150 points) = Judging panel score (70 points) + HMS bonus points( 70) + Other bonus points (10 points),【Judging panel score】User experience (10 points): The submitted app is stable and functional, with impressive user interactions, a user-friendly interface, and appealing visuals and sounds. Originality (30 points): The submitted app is loaded with unique and innovative functions that cannot be found in similar apps, ensuring long-term user appeal. Social value (30 points): The submitted app addresses an issue of widespread concern, and offers new solutions for a specific user group and/or scenario.【HMS bonus points5 points will be added for integrating each of the following: Map Kit, Location Kit, 10 points will be added for integrating each of the following: Audio Editor Kit, Video Editor Kit, Health Kit, Drive Kit, ML Kit, AR Engine Kit,【Other bonus points) Other bonus points, which are capped at 10 points. 2 points will be added for integrating other HMS capabilities.
Prizes: Each member of the winning team will get HUAWEI Watch GT2 smart watch (the value of one smartwatch is: 139 EUR)
description_zh: 华为过去30年成功的基础是专注于由消费者需求驱动的技术和工程创新，被波士顿咨询集团（BCG）列为全球第六大最具创新力的公司。未来，华为将继续追求由消费者需求驱动的创新，并与对未来的共同愿景一道，实现与全球共同的技术领导地位。
insights_zh: 移动应用是实现数字创新的关键技术，可以通过将知识应用于创建应用来解决现实生活中的问题来实现。在Junction 2022期间，他们挑战我们的参与者构建一个原型移动应用/游戏，使用推荐的华为移动服务SDK实现关于远程工作的创新想法。\n\n移动应用或游戏不必复杂才能有效。应用或游戏应尝试解决关于远程工作的现实生活问题。应用必须包含推荐的HMS SDK之一才有资格。了解更多关于HMS Core的信息：https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/en/develop/
judging_criteria_zh: 评分规则：总分（150分）= 评审团评分（70分）+ HMS奖励分（70分）+ 其他奖励分（10分）。【评审团评分】用户体验（10分）：提交的应用稳定且功能完善，具有令人印象深刻的用户交互、用户友好的界面以及吸引人的视觉和声音效果。原创性（30分）：提交的应用具有独特且创新的功能，这些功能在类似应用中找不到，确保长期用户吸引力。社会价值（30分）：提交的应用解决了一个广泛关注的问题，并为特定用户群体和/或场景提供了新的解决方案。【HMS奖励分】集成以下每一项将增加5分：Map Kit、Location Kit；集成以下每一项将增加10分：Audio Editor Kit、Video Editor Kit、Health Kit、Drive Kit、ML Kit、AR Engine Kit。【其他奖励分】其他奖励分，上限为10分。集成其他HMS能力将增加2分。
prizes_zh: 获胜团队的每位成员将获得HUAWEI Watch GT2智能手表（一块智能手表的价值为：139欧元）
resources_zh: 现场导师在挑战期间提供协助。华为HMS测试设备和测试开发者账户。适用于Native Android、React Native和Flutter的华为移动服务入门项目、API链接和文档。

Challenge name: Paving the way for tomorrow’s inventions
Description: Finland is known for the inventiveness, creativity, and pragmatic problem-solving capabilities of the people and society. Finnish inventors rank high in global patent applications and large companies have world-class R&D management and processes.  \\nEntrepreneurs and inventors have a great number of innovative ideas and seeds of inventions. They have, however, great difficulties in making these new ideas come to life and developing their early-stage inventions into marketable, successful innovations.  \\nTo solve the problem, Keksintösäätiö is building a country-wide network of experts from various fields to assess, evaluate, spar, and support entrepreneurs and inventors in their ventures. The Ideajalostamo-program engages these experts and innovation support organizations to form an “umbrella” for delivering enhanced support for target groups.
