With deep resources—including advanced GPU/TPU infrastructure, industry-grade datasets, and world-class developer tooling—Google Cloud supports teams aiming to push the boundaries of applied AI. name_zh: 最佳 Google Cloud 应用
description_zh: 在您的黑客松项目中使用 Google Cloud。利用最先进的机器学习工具、可扩展的基础设施、各种无服务器技术以及易于使用的 DevOps 工具，让您能够专注于项目挑战。解决问题的方法往往不止一种。请花时间仔细考虑“您要解决的问题是什么”、“解决方案将帮助谁”。一旦您缩小了这些问题的答案范围，就更容易开始选择最适合您的技术。
judging_criteria_zh: 要获得奖品，我们期望您展示在解决方案中结合 Google Cloud 服务的创意和创新方式。
prizes_zh: 获奖者将获得一些 Google 周边礼品。

about_company_zh: Google Cloud 是云计算、AI 基础设施和数据驱动创新领域的全球领导者，为从初创公司到全球最大企业的组织提供支持。该公司专注于帮助开发者部署可扩展架构、利用最先进的 AI 模型，并安全地加速数字化转型。凭借深厚的资源——包括先进的 GPU/TPU 基础设施、行业级数据集和世界一流的开发者工具——Google Cloud 支持旨在推动应用 AI 边界的团队。在 Junction，Google Cloud 参与其中，以促进其平台上的真实实验，并识别可全球扩展的下一代解决方案。

Description:
Create an impactful AI-driven solution using SAS Customer Intelligence 360 or SAS Viya.

SAS empowers organizations worldwide to turn data into insights and insights into action. In this challenge, we invite you to explore how SAS Customer Intelligence 360 and SAS Viya can be leveraged to build innovative, efficient, and intelligent solutions. Whether it’s optimizing decision-making, automating processes, or personalizing digital experiences, your creativity will define what’s possible with SAS technologies.

Your goal is to design and prototype a use case demonstrating the most creative and meaningful application of SAS Customer Intelligence 360 or SAS Viya. We’re looking for projects that highlight how these tools can harness data and AI to drive productivity, insights, and real-world impact. The problem domain is completely open—choose any industry, audience, or use case where smarter analytics can make a difference.
Insights: We’re inspired by ideas that connect advanced analytics with tangible user or business value: personalized marketing journeys, data-driven decision optimization, and intelligent automation. Show how SAS tools can power tomorrow’s AI solutions.
Resources:
Mentors from SAS’s product and consulting teams will be available throughout the hackathon, with expertise in analytics, customer intelligence, and AI-driven optimization.

SAS Viya (cloud-native analytics platform)

SAS Customer Intelligence 360 (marketing intelligence platform)

Access to mentor support from SAS experts

Documentation and tutorials for both platforms"
Judging criteria: We will evaluate projects based on their creativity, real-world relevance, impact potential, and effective use of SAS platforms. The best project clearly demonstrates how SAS tools enhance productivity through AI and data-driven insight.
About Company: SAS is a global leader in analytics and AI, helping businesses and governments make better decisions through trusted data and advanced analytics. With over four decades of experience, SAS continues to push the boundaries of what data can do. At Junction, SAS seeks to collaborate with creative problem solvers and future innovators who use AI to turn complex data into meaningful progress.
description_zh:
使用SAS Customer Intelligence 360或SAS Viya创建具有影响力的AI驱动解决方案。

SAS帮助全球组织将数据转化为洞察，并将洞察转化为行动。在本次挑战中，我们邀请您探索如何利用SAS Customer Intelligence 360和SAS Viya构建创新、高效且智能的解决方案。无论是优化决策、自动化流程还是个性化数字体验，您的创造力将定义SAS技术的可能性。

您的目标是设计并原型化一个用例，展示SAS Customer Intelligence 360或SAS Viya最具创意和意义的应用。我们正在寻找能够突出这些工具如何利用数据和AI推动生产力、洞察力和现实世界影响的项目。问题领域完全开放——选择任何行业、受众或用例，只要更智能的分析能够发挥作用。
insights_zh: 我们受到将高级分析与切实的用户或商业价值相结合的想法启发：个性化营销旅程、数据驱动的决策优化和智能自动化。展示SAS工具如何为未来的AI解决方案提供动力。
judging_criteria_zh: 我们将根据项目的创造性、现实相关性、影响潜力以及对SAS平台的有效使用来评估项目。最佳项目应清晰展示SAS工具如何通过AI和数据驱动的洞察提升生产力。
resources_zh:
来自SAS产品和咨询团队的导师将在整个黑客松期间提供支持，他们在分析、客户智能和AI驱动的优化方面拥有专业知识。

SAS Viya（云原生分析平台）

SAS Customer Intelligence 360（营销智能平台）

获得SAS专家的导师支持

两个平台的文档和教程
about_company_zh: SAS是分析和AI领域的全球领导者，通过可信数据和高级分析帮助企业和政府做出更好的决策。凭借四十多年的经验，SAS不断突破数据的边界。在Junction，SAS寻求与创造性的问题解决者和未来创新者合作，他们使用AI将复杂数据转化为有意义的进展。

Description:
Get started in 3 steps

1. Sign up for Feather Premium
--> Sign up at featherless.ai
--> go to the Pricing
--> Select Feather Premium and fill in coupon code JUNCTION

2. Get your API key
--> After subscribing, go to the top right and click on API Keys
